title: Director of Registration & Licensure
description:
## Director of Registration & Licensure

## Moncton, New Brunswick

## Reference #JL-NBCP-10163

The New Brunswick College of Pharmacists (NBCP) is the regulatory body responsible for protecting the public and advancing excellence in the practice of pharmacy throughout New Brunswick. The College licenses and regulates pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, and pharmacies in support of safe, ethical, and competent pharmacy practice across the province.

NBCP is entering an exciting period of transformation. As the regulatory environment continues to evolve through labour mobility initiatives, registration modernization, legislative reform, and workforce development, the College is building its leadership capacity to help shape the future of pharmacy regulation in New Brunswick.

On behalf of NBCP, Meridia Recruitment Solutions is seeking a Director of Registration & Licensure to join the organization in a newly established leadership role.

## The Role

Reporting to the Deputy Registrar, the Director of Registration & Licensure will provide strategic leadership for the College's registration and licensure portfolio, overseeing regulatory processes that ensure registration and licensing decisions are fair, transparent, efficient, and aligned with the College's public protection mandate.

This is a unique opportunity to lead modernization initiatives that will help shape the future of pharmacy regulation in New Brunswick. The successful candidate will support critical priorities including registration system modernization, labour mobility initiatives, licensure pathway development, educational partnerships, workforce planning, and future legislative reform.

Working closely with College leadership, staff, government partners, educational institutions, and national regulatory organizations, the Director will serve as a key contributor to strategic decision-making and organizational growth.

## Why Join NBCP?

This is a rare opportunity to join a progressive regulator at a pivotal point in its evolution. As the College advances labour mobility initiatives, modernizes registration and licensure systems, develops innovative pathways for internationally educated pharmacy professionals, and supports future pharmacy workforce development, the successful candidate will play a central role in shaping the future of pharmacy regulation in New Brunswick. This role offers the opportunity to influence policy, support legislative reform, build strategic partnerships, and leave a lasting impact on the profession.

## Duties & Responsibilities:

• Provide strategic leadership for the College's registration and licensure functions, including departmental planning, priorities, service standards, and performance outcomes.

• Lead the ongoing modernization of registration and licensure processes, systems, policies, and regulatory frameworks.

• Oversee registration, licensure, renewal, reinstatement, applicant assessment, and related regulatory activities.

• Lead the review and modernization of registrant and pharmacy registers, ensuring data quality, consistency, and regulatory compliance.

• Define and support the implementation of business and regulatory requirements for enhancements to registration systems, databases, and applicant-facing technology platforms.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to identify opportunities for regulatory improvement and operational efficiency.

• Provide leadership on policy development, process reviews, and regulatory initiatives that support public protection while reducing unnecessary barriers to registration.

• Support educational and practice-readiness initiatives, including partnerships with educational institutions, workforce development programs, and credential recognition processes.

• Support the development and implementation of innovative registration, education, assessment, and licensure pathways for internationally educated pharmacy professionals, while advancing labour mobility and workforce development initiatives.

• Contribute to legislative and regulatory reform initiatives, including future amendments to the Pharmacy Act and related regulations.

• Prepare briefing materials, reports, recommendations, and presentations for senior leadership, Council, and committees.

• Build strong relationships with registrants, applicants, educational institutions, government partners, national assessment organizations, and other regulatory bodies.

• Provide leadership, coaching, and support to direct reports while fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture.

• Represent the College on provincial, regional, and national working groups and committees as required.

• Monitor emerging regulatory, educational, and workforce trends and provide recommendations to support the College's strategic priorities.

## Qualifications & Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in public administration, education, health administration, business, law, or another relevant discipline.

• 5-10 years of progressive leadership experience within professional regulation, credentialing, licensing, higher education administration, healthcare, certification, public administration, or a related field.

• Experience leading complex projects, organizational change initiatives, policy development, or process modernization efforts.

title: Early Childhood Educator, Child Study Centre
description:
The Child Study Centre at Mount Saint Vincent University invites applications for the position of Early Childhood Educator.

## MSVU Child Study Centre - Who We Are & What We Care About

Mount Saint Vincent University's Child Study Centre is entering an exciting new chapter as we prepare to open the expanded and new child care facility in early Spring 2027.

Founded in 1976, the Child Study Centre is a licensed, not-for-profit early learning and child care centre committed to providing high-quality, inclusive, accessible, and culturally responsive programming for young children. We create environments where children and educators are inspired to explore, create, and grow, while honouring diverse identities, experiences and ways of knowing.

As a university-based child care centre, we work closely with the MSVU community and the Child and Youth Study program. Our educators have unique opportunities to mentor students, engage with research, contribute to innovative practice, and help shape the future of early childhood education and care in Nova Scotia.

We are inspired by the Reggio Emilia Approach, and our work is guided by the Nova Scotia Early Learning Curriculum Framework and a commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion, belonging, social justice, and environmental responsibility. We recognize that creating equitable and inclusive environments requires ongoing reflection, learning, and action. We are committed to the ongoing work of decolonization, and believe that reflective practice, curiosity, and lifelong learning strengthen both individuals and communities.

We strive to create a workplace and space where educators feel supported, respected, and inspired to continue learning throughout their careers.

## About the Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Child Study Centre, the Early Childhood Educator contributes to a safe, inclusive, and responsive environment where children are recognized as capable, curious, and active participants in their learning and experiences. The Early Childhood Educator works collaboratively with children, families, and colleagues to observe, document, and develop responsive curriculum that emerges from children's interests, ideas, relationships, and experiences. The role includes supporting children's well-being, belonging, and participation; creating thoughtful indoor and outdoor environments; and engaging in reflective pedagogical practice and collaborative inquiry.

Qualifications
The ideal candidate will bring a minimum of 3 years of experience working with children in an ECE classroom and an ECE Level 2 or higher. The candidate will need to be familiar with the Nova Scotia Early Learning Curriculum Framework and have experience working with children using an emergent curriculum approach. They will be familiar with observing children and recording these observations to create relevant curriculum experiences in the classroom. The candidate will have excellent written and verbal communication skills and should be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite.

The candidate will demonstrate a genuine appreciation for children and their abilities. The candidate must be able to work as part of a team of educators and work cooperatively with families. Willingness to continue with professional development and education is a must. First Aid and CPR certification is required.

Experience with pedagogical documentation would be an asset. Specific work experience with children below three years of age is an asset.

The successful candidate will be required to undergo a Child Abuse Registry check, Vulnerable Sector check, and Criminal Records check.

Responsibilities
• Co-create, implement, and reflect on responsive curriculum and learning experiences.

• Create safe, inclusive, and engaging indoor and outdoor environments.

• Observe and document children's interests, ideas, experiences, and participation.

• Build respectful, reciprocal relationships with children, families, and colleagues.

• Mentor and support practicum students and volunteers.

• Engage in ongoing professional learning, reflective practice, and quality improvement initiatives.

## Salary

In accordance with the Nova Scotia Early Childhood Educator Wage Scale.

## Start Date

Winter 2027 - exact date will be determined by the Child Study Centre opening timeline.

## Application Process

Applications should include a cover letter and a resume. The position will remain open until filled; however, applications will start being reviewed on October 28, 2026.

title: Corporate Controller
description:
## Corporate Controller
Halifax, NS
Reference # HL-PMS-10213

Since 1999, Premiere Suites has been one of Canada's most recognized and trusted providers of high-quality temporary residences for professionals and families. Offering furnished apartments, condominiums, and townhomes for extended stays of 30 days or more, Premiere Suites serves guests across Canada with a focus on quality, consistency, and exceptional service.

Reporting to the Vice President of Finance and Technology, the Corporate Controller will play a key leadership role in overseeing the organization's accounting operations, financial reporting, planning, forecasting, and performance analysis. This position will provide meaningful financial and operational insights to support decision-making while strengthening financial discipline, controls, processes, and reporting across the organization.

## Key responsibilities include:

Financial Reporting & Planning

• Lead accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close and reporting processes

• Prepare and review financial statements, management reporting, and detailed variance analysis

• Own the annual budgeting and rolling forecasting processes, including financial models, assumptions, and scenario analysis

• Partner with department leaders to align financial plans with business priorities and recommend actions based on performance against plan

Financial Analysis & Business Insights

• Analyze profitability across suites, customers, regions, and strategic initiatives

• Develop and maintain operational dashboards and KPIs, including occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and cost trends

• Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and clearly communicate the story behind the numbers to leadership

• Incorporate relevant external data to support benchmarking, competitive analysis, and informed decision-making

• Support strategic initiatives, investment analysis, and growth planning across the organization

Cash Flow & Financial Controls

• Manage daily liquidity, working capital, and short- and long-term cash flow forecasting

• Support banking relationships and organizational financing requirements

• Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure financial processes and procedures are appropriately documented

• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, organizational policies, and regulatory requirements

• Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors

Data Systems & Process Improvement

• Integrate financial and operational data from QuickBooks, CRM, and other business systems to strengthen reporting and analysis

• Ensure accuracy and consistency across financial and operational data sources

• Leverage advanced Excel, Power BI, and other technology to automate and enhance reporting

• Identify opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual work, standardize reporting, and improve scalability

• Support data centralization and systems initiatives that enhance financial visibility across the business

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Act as a trusted financial partner to Operations, Sales, Marketing, and other functional leaders

• Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, banks, auditors, and external partners

• Promote accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making throughout the organization

## The ideal candidate will possess:

• CPA designation is required

• 7+ years of progressive accounting, controllership, and financial planning and analysis experience

• Strong expertise in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and performance analysis

• Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or similar tools is preferred

• Strong knowledge of QuickBooks Online and experience working with CRM and operational data

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights

• Excellent communication and business partnership skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and with senior leadership

• Demonstrated experience driving process improvement, automation, and operational efficiencies

• A proactive, hands-on approach with strong attention to detail and the ability to operate effectively in a growing environment

This is an exciting opportunity to join an established organization and play a key role in strengthening its finance function during a period of continued growth. The Corporate Controller will have broad exposure across the business, with the opportunity to influence financial strategy, enhance reporting and analytics, and support key operational and strategic decisions.

If there are no Advanced Care Paramedic applicants, we will consider applications from Primary Care Paramedics (PCP) and Ambulance Operators/Attendants (also known as Emergency Medical Responder (EMR)). We prioritize candidates based on their qualifications in the following order: Advanced Care Paramedic, Primary Care Paramedic, or Ambulance Operator/Attendant.

If the competition is awarded to a PCP or EMR as the next highest classification, they will be temporarily awarded the position for the same number of hours indicated above and recruitment will continue for the higher classification.

## Job Summary:

The Advanced Care Paramedic (or Primary Care Paramedic, or Ambulance Operator/Attendant), works as an integral part of the paramedicine program. The successful applicant will work within their scope of practice, including responding to emergency and routine calls, providing skilled basic and advanced emergency care or assistance to people suffering from a variety of injuries or illnesses. The successful applicant is responsible for maintaining professional and organizational standards of practice.

The successful applicant must demonstrate an awareness of and be responsible for promoting and supporting person-and family-centered care, demonstrate a commitment to safety and partner with all team members to improve worker and patient safety by integrating safety into work practices, identifying risks and implementing improvements. The successful applicant may be required to provide preceptorship and mentorship to students and new employees during clinical placements and orientation periods.

The successful applicant will report directly to the Manager of District Operations of Paramedicine.

## Duties/Job Demands:

The Advanced Care Paramedic performs independent advanced medical care and intervention to patients at pre-hospital scene settings. This includes operating ambulances in responding to emergencies and routine calls; conducting physical examinations; performing comprehensive assessments and tests; interpreting a variety of tests and procedures; initiating a variety of advanced interventions; and performing other related duties as required. Work is performed with considerable independence and is reviewed through observation, examination of records and reports, and the presence or absence of valid complaints. The ACP functions as a leader and mentor within the paramedicine program.

The Primary Care Paramedic works as an active member of the health care team providing pre-hospital assessment and medical care to people with acute illnesses or injuries while maintaining a high standard of care to the patients. Work is performed with considerable independence and is reviewed through observation, examination of records and reports, and the presence or absence of valid complaints. The Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) functions as part of an interdisciplinary team within healthcare facility units and ensures client and staff safety, and other related duties as required.

The Ambulance Operator/Attendant (EMR) will be responsible for skilled work in the operation of ambulances in transporting patients while exercising care and skill in driving. The successful incumbent will aid the paramedicine staff in patient care, such as proper lifting of patients and other related duties as required.

## Job Demands:

By applying for this job, you acknowledge an understanding that regular requirements and demands of this job include (but are not limited to):

• Regularly lifts and moves patients and equipment (between 25-50 lbs.) and involved in heavy lifting/pushing/pulling of stretchers (100 lbs.) and patients;

• Constantly stands, bends, stretches, kneels or pushes and pulls; sometimes in small and cramped spaces.

• Constantly requires visual concentration or alertness to drive ambulances, complete site and patient assessments and to administer medications. Regularly there are time pressures in the pre-hospital emergency setting.

• Regularly there is lack of control over work pace occurs due to the unpredictable situations during a medical emergency, or unpredictable call volume

## Qualifications:

• Graduation from an approved Advanced Care Paramedic or Primary Care Paramedic program, or Emergency Medical Responder course (10-day course) accredited by the Canadian Medical Association;

• Current registration with the NL Paramedicine Regulation as an ACP, PCP or EMR;

• Possession of a valid Class 4 Driver's License as issued by the Province of Newfoundland and Labrador;

• Medical authorization with the Office of the Provincial Medical Director (OPMD) is required and must be obtained upon successful completion of program orientation;

• Current certification in Basic Life Support;

• Current ACLS certification (ACP only);

• Current certification in PALS, or willingness to complete (ACP only)

• Effective oral and written communication skills;

• Critical and sound decision making skills;

• Successful completion of the Physical Capability testing certificate (within the last 3 months) and continued responsibility to meet the minimum standards of physical capability as outlined in provincial policy;

• For standby, must be able to report to work within the required timeframe of 10 minutes or be willing to stay at the base.

• A satisfactory record of work performance and attendance is required for this position;

• A satisfactory Driver’s Abstract from Motor Vehicle Registration is required;

• A satisfactory certificate of conduct from the RCMP or local police authority;

• Consistent demonstration of NL Health Service's core values; Innovation, Compassion, Accountability, Respect and Excellence (ICARE)

To assist us in processing your application, please include your Class 4 License, Driver's Abstract, and NLPR Registration (if obtained), along with your up-to-date resume, when applying for this position.

## The Company

Russon Construction is a well-established construction company serving commercial and residential clients throughout Fredericton and the surrounding area. Since 2008, we have built our reputation on quality workmanship, attention to detail, and delivering projects that exceed our clients' expectations.

## The Opportunity

This is an opportunity for an experienced construction professional who takes pride in their work and enjoys leading a team. At Russon Construction, we believe carpentry is more than a trade-it's a profession. We are looking for someone who shares that mindset and understands that a successful project requires quality workmanship, good communication, organization, and leadership.

As a Construction Foreman, you will oversee day-to-day activities on site, coordinate employees and subcontractors, maintain our quality standards, and help ensure projects stay on schedule. This is a hands-on position. Our foremen lead from the front and work alongside the crew when required.

Our normal work hours are 7:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday, and we generally finish our work week at noon on Fridays. Occasionally, evening or weekend work may be required to accommodate project or client needs.

Pay: $27.00 to $35.00 per hour, based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated leadership ability.

## Responsibilities

• Lead and supervise employees on commercial and residential construction projects.

• Plan and coordinate daily site activities.

• Read and interpret construction drawings and specifications.

• Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, deliveries, and materials.

• Assign work and provide direction to crew members.

• Maintain high standards for workmanship and productivity.

• Monitor project schedules and communicate progress or concerns.

• Identify site issues and help develop practical solutions.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and professional job site.

• Promote and maintain safe work practices.

• Communicate professionally with clients, subcontractors, suppliers.

• Perform hands-on carpentry and construction work as required.

## The Person

The successful candidate will be an experienced construction professional who is comfortable taking responsibility for a project and leading a crew. The ideal candidate will have:

• Red Seal Carpenter certification, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.

• A minimum of five years of construction experience.

• Strong experience in residential and/or commercial construction.

• Previous experience supervising or leading a construction crew.

• Strong knowledge of construction methods, materials, and sequencing.

• Ability to read and understand construction drawings.

• Ability to plan ahead, organize work, and keep projects moving.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

• A professional attitude and strong commitment to quality workmanship.

• A valid driver's license with a clean driver's abstract.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, leads by example, and understands the importance of doing the job properly.

## To Apply

Please send your resume to jason@russonconstruction.com

We appreciate everyone who takes the time to apply. Candidates whose experience and qualifications are a good fit for the position will be contacted for an interview. References are not required with your initial application; however, references may be requested prior to an offer of employment.

title: Fish Handling Labourer
description:
Hermitage Processing Inc., a Division of Cooke Aquaculture Inc., a dynamic and growing east coast family company, with Platinum Member status in the Canada's Best Managed Companies Program, is offering a unique opportunity for the right individual to join the Processing Team as Fish Handling Labourer.

Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, and South America. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly-skilled and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

## Position Summary

The Fish Handling Labourer is responsible for receiving, handling, sorting, grading, weighing, transferring, and preparing fish and seafood products for storage, processing, and shipment. The position supports daily seafood operations by moving products between receiving, holding, processing, storage, and loading areas; operating material handling equipment; loading and unloading transportation vehicles; and maintaining product quality and food safety standards. Employees may also assist with fish processing, packaging, and production activities as operational requirements dictate.

## Duties and Responsibilities

The employee will perform some or all of the following duties:

• Receive fish and seafood products from holding tanks, receiving areas, and other designated work areas.

• Transfer fish and seafood products between holding tanks, coolers, storage facilities, processing areas, and loading areas.

• Assist with the transfer and handling of fish and seafood products from vessels when operationally required.

• Sort, grade, weigh, inspect, and record fish and seafood products according to species, size, quality standards, and destination requirements.

• Prepare fish and seafood products for storage and shipment by icing, packing, palletizing, and staging products for transport.

• Load and unload trucks and other transportation vehicles for the movement and shipment of fish and seafood products.

• Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment to move products, packaging materials, and supplies throughout the facility.

• Assist with shipping, receiving, inventory control, and product traceability activities.

• Clean and sanitize tanks, equipment, work areas, coolers, loading areas, and storage facilities

• Follow all food safety, quality assurance, biosecurity, occupational health and safety, and company policies and procedures.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.

Secondary Duties and Responsibilities

(Performed as required based on operational needs)

• Assist fish processing operations, including cleaning, trimming, grading, filleting, packaging, and preparing fish and seafood products for further processing or shipment.

• Support production-line operations during periods of increased production demand.

## Employment Requirements

• No formal education required.

• Previous fish processing, seafood handling, warehouse, shipping/receiving, wharf operations, or general labour experience is considered an asset.

• Forklift experience is considered an asset.

• Ability to work in a physically demanding environment.

• Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

• Ability to follow workplace safety procedures and operational instructions.

## Work Conditions and Physical Capabilities

• Repetitive tasks.

• Physically demanding work.

• Frequent lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling of products and materials.

• Standing and walking for extended periods.

• Bending, crouching, and reaching.

• Exposure to wet, cold, humid, and outdoor conditions.

• Overtime and weekend work may be required based on operational needs.

## The Opportunity

The role description is just one part of the story. This is an opportunity to grow, to work within the parameters of the role but to reach your fullest potential. We are a team that is driven to succeed. We count performance, we reward contribution, and we recognize talent. It is about being at the center of a global leader in seafood and knowing you are part of that growth. The ability to bring your passion for learning, desire for growth and energy for moving your career forward is what we offer.

Why Cooke ? Simple, because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

We appreciate all resumes; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

description:
At PAL Airlines, we are dedicated to providing our customers with a reliable on-time performance, memorable travel experiences, and outstanding customer service. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, have a love of travel, take pride and ownership in what you do and have exceptional customer service skills, then you're the person we are looking for!

PAL Airlines is currently seeking a Full-Time Permanent Reservations Agent to join our team in St. John's, NL.

As a Reservations Agent based in Canada, you will play a critical role in delivering exceptional customer service by managing and processing reservation requests efficiently and accurately. Your primary objective will be to assist customers in booking accommodations, transportation, or other services, ensuring their needs and preferences are met with professionalism and care. • Coordinate with other departments such as front desk, housekeeping, or transportation to ensure smooth service delivery.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of promotions, packages, and seasonal offers to maximize sales opportunities.

• Resolve customer complaints or issues efficiently, escalating complex cases to supervisors when necessary.

• Document all interactions and transactions thoroughly to ensure accurate records and reporting.

## Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Proven experience in a customer service or reservations role, preferably within the hospitality or travel industry.

• Proficiency in using reservation and booking software.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

description:
## Purpose of position

The AI Solutions Architect designs, governs, develops and delivers enterprise AI solutions aligned with Jazz architecture, security, compliance, data governance requirements and ensures deployed AI solutions remain secure, reliable, compliant, supportable, and effective throughout their operational lifecycle. The role actively builds critical solution components in conjunction with the Software Development team and AI Analysts, translating business needs into secure, supportable and measurable production capabilities.

• Define success measures and partner with business owners, AI Analysts and adoption leads to support readiness, adoption, value tracking and post-implementation optimization.

• Ensure solutions remain effective, secure, compliant, and cost-efficient throughout their lifecycle.

• Apply Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, records management and data governance requirements.

• Support AI governance, architecture review and risk-management activities.

• Support AI cost-governance practices, including forecasting, consumption monitoring, budget alerts, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), and value-realization reporting.

## Required qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent education and experience may be considered.

• 5+ years working in IT, designing and developing enterprise solutions.

• Experience with Generative AI, Machine Learning or Advanced Analytics.

• Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Prompt Engineering or Responsible AI principles.

• Experience in API design, Enterprise Integration.

• Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, testing and monitoring practices.

• Knowledge of secure development, privacy and data governance practices.

• Strong business analysis, facilitation, technical writing, stakeholder communication skills, strategic relationship-building and change leadership skills.

• Advanced experience in Enterprise Solution Architecture, Software Development, Data Architecture or Cloud Architecture.

• Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary development and business teams and moving solutions from concept to production.

• Strategic and systems thinking skills.

title: Aircraft Maintenance Auditor
description:
## Join a Team That Keeps Aircraft Safe, Compliant, and Mission Ready!

PAL Technical Services is a leader in full-service aircraft maintenance, providing a comprehensive range of aviation services including aircraft modifications, line maintenance, maintenance repair and overhaul (MRO), and engineering support. As the maintenance division of the PAL Group of Companies, we support both domestic and international operations while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.

We are currently seeking an Aircraft Maintenance Auditor to join our team in St. John's, NL.

In this role, you will provide independent oversight of maintenance operations, technical records, airworthiness programs, and quality systems to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, company procedures, and industry standards. You will play a key role in supporting our Safety Management System (SMS), Quality Management System (QMS), and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

## What You'll Do

## Audit & Compliance

• Conduct audits of aircraft maintenance operations, airworthiness activities, maintenance planning, technical records, supply chain, stores, and maintenance control functions.

• Assess compliance with Canadian Aviation Regulations (CARs), company manuals, SMS requirements, and applicable industry standards.

• Monitor ongoing compliance with Transport Canada requirements and organizational procedures.

• Support regulatory inspections, certification audits, and customer oversight activities.

## Audit Reporting & Corrective Actions

• Prepare detailed audit reports and document findings, observations, and non-conformances.

• Support root cause analysis and corrective action development.

• Track corrective actions through to completion and verify effectiveness.

## Continuous Improvement & Risk Management

• Identify quality, safety, and airworthiness risks.

• Analyze trends and recurring audit findings.

• Recommend improvements that enhance compliance, operational effectiveness, and overall system performance.

## Supplier & Contractor Oversight

• Conduct supplier and vendor audits.

• Assess contracted maintenance providers for regulatory and contractual compliance.

• Evaluate supplier quality systems and corrective action effectiveness.

## Records & Documentation Review

• Review maintenance records and documentation for accuracy, completeness, and traceability.

• Verify compliance with document control and record retention requirements.

## What You'll Bring

## Required Qualifications

• Diploma or Degree in Aviation Maintenance, Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Assurance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Minimum 5 years of aviation maintenance experience.

• Strong knowledge of:
• Canadian Aviation Regulations (CARs)

• Continuing Airworthiness requirements

• Maintenance Control Systems

• Safety Management Systems (SMS)

• Quality Management Systems (QMS)

## Preferred Qualifications

• Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (AME) Licence.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in quality assurance, auditing, regulatory compliance, airworthiness, or maintenance management.

• AS9110, ISO 9001, Internal Auditor, or Lead Auditor certification.

• SMS Auditor Training.

• Human Factors Training.

• Experience working within a Transport Canada-regulated environment.

## Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and investigative abilities.

• Excellent communication and report-writing skills.

• Root cause analysis and corrective action management experience.

• Exceptional attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently while maintaining auditor objectivity.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

## Working Conditions

• Travel to maintenance bases, hangars, operational facilities, and supplier locations will be required.

• Combination of office, hangar, and field-based work environments.

• Occasional evening and weekend work to support audits, inspections, and operational requirements.

## Why Work for PAL?

At PAL, we recognize that our people are our greatest asset. That's why we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally.

## The Perks of Being One of Our PALs

• Personal travel privileges with PAL and interline agreements with multiple airlines

• Industry and partner discounts

• Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage

• Pension Plan with Employer Matching

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Employee Tuition Assistance Program

• Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP)

title: Guest Experience Coordinator
description:
Guest Experience CoordinatorDepartment of Tourism, Heritage and CulturePersonal Service ContractOpen CompetitionMount Carleton Provincial Park

Interested in making a difference in our province? We encourage you to Choose GNB!

Join us and be part of a team that shares a passion for nature, outdoor activities and enhancing visitor experiences at this beautiful and beloved destination!

## Who we are:

Located in the heart of New Brunswick, Mount Carleton Provincial Park is a breathtaking destination committed to preserving and showcasing the natural beauty of the Appalachian Mountain Range. As the highest peak in the Maritimes, Mount Carleton offers visitors a unique experience, with over 42,000 acres of pristine wilderness to explore.

Our park is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts, offering opportunities for hiking, camping, fishing and stargazing in one of the darkest skies in Eastern Canada. With a rich cultural history and a deep commitment to conservation, Mount Carleton is more than a scenic retreat - it's a place to connect with nature, to explore diverse ecosystems and to enjoy unforgettable experiences.

Joining our team means becoming part of a community dedicated to providing exceptional service to visitors, promoting environmental stewardship, and sharing the wonders of New Brunswick's natural heritage.

## What you will do:

Reporting to the Assistant Park Manager, the successful candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering recreational and special event programming that enhances the visitor experience at Mount Carleton Provincial Park.

The duties and responsibilities will include:

• Developing inspiring seasonal activities for all ages that promote the Park's natural and cultural resource activities while respecting the NB Parks brand

• Coordinating event logistics and delivery of experiences with supervisors and managers

• Working with Tourism partners, community groups and local organizations

• Maintaining relationships and liaising with the ministry's marketing and product innovation teams

• Performing other tasks as required

## Who you are:

To be successful in this role, you have a great respect for health and safety procedures and are able to work independently as well as part of a team. You are able to prioritize tasks and think critically.

Your attitude, skills and interests are just as important as your area of study. We are looking for diverse backgrounds that bring a combination of the following

## Required Competencies:

• Bachelor's Degree in Recreation Management, Tourism, Event Management, Outdoor Recreation, Education, Communications, Marketing, or a related field and a minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience OR a Post-secondary Diploma in Recreation Management, Tourism, Event Management, Outdoor Recreation, Education, Communications, Marketing, or a related field and a minimum of four (4) years of experience

• Experience in coordinating events, recreational programming, community engagement, or tourism-related activities

• Strong event planning and organizational skills

• Valid class 5 driver's license as issued by the Province of New Brunswick

• An equivalent combination of education, trainingand experience may be considered.

Written and spoken competence in English and French is required. Please state your language capability.

Applicants must clearly demonstrate the essential qualifications to be given further consideration. Please ensure that preferred language for assessment is identified on your resume.

Résumés should be in chronological order specifying education and employment in months and years including part-time and full-time employment.

Pay Band 3 - $2,098.00 to $2,932.00 biweekly

• Office location: Mount Carleton Provincial Park

• Working evenings, weekends, holidays, shifts and variable hours according to assigned schedule

• Occasional travel throughout the province may be required

• We promote a scent-reduced environment

## What can GNB offer you?

• Comprehensive benefits package which includes which includes 1.25 days/month of paid vacation, Health and Dental Plan, Life Insurance, and the New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan

• Opportunities for career growth, professional development, and training

• Free access to Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) and services

Providing a safe workplace for all. Your health & safety are important to us. GNB has implemented preventative measures across the organization to ensure your health & safety.

description:

45742TMP

Posted Date: 2026-09-14

Closing Date: Open until filled.

Definition of work:
Reporting to the Provincial Manager of Supplier Relationship Management, this position will support the vision and mandate of the Supply Chain Department by managing suppliers to provide the right quality product, on-time, as needed, where needed in line with the contract to better meet the customers’ and organizations’ requirements for: quality, safety, reliability, operational efficiency and overall value. The SRM Analyst (Procurement Officer III) supports the division’s transformation and integration of supplier strategy, engagement, policies, processes and procedures into the Supply Chain Department to ensure the appropriate and timely flow of goods through the health care facilities, networks, and systems in an effort to assist NLHS to achieve its strategic goals. This position will develop effective working relationships and communicate regularly with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
This will require excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including sensitivity, tact and diplomacy and the ability to appropriately handle contentious
conversations.

In that capacity, this position will:
• Contribute and maintain supplier management framework to support the development and ongoing maintenance of strong supplier relationships.

• Help establish, operationalize and continuously improve supplier set-up, orientation, on-boarding, credentialing, and segmentation.

• Work collaboratively with stakeholders to provide support and subject matter expertise on the identification and development of KPI’s and assist in enabling value for money and risk mitigation.

• Evaluate, track and report on key supplier performance measures, analyze quantitative and qualitative results and report and identify new opportunities for cost savings and/or service improvement programs that support and align Supply Chain’s and NLHS’s strategic goals, using techniques such as Lean, Six Sigma, Total Quality Management, Value Mapping, etc.

• Develop, maintain and enhance supplier and management tools (e.g. tracking tools, scorecards and dashboards) to monitor performance against contract language and NLHS expectations.

• Evaluate contract effectiveness and inform Sourcing and Contracts of potential changes to terms and conditions of future competitive bidding and contract documents to ensure positive stakeholder relationships.

• Celebrate and recognize positive supplier performance and work with applicable stakeholders (including: suppliers, senior leadership, legal counsel, and Public Procurement Agency staff) to performance manage, restrict, or terminate suppliers who are not performing. This includes: mediating disputes between suppliers, Public Procurement Agency, and end-users to ensure compliance to contracts, Public Procurement Act, and minimize legal risks.

• Participate in meetings with end users, suppliers and stakeholders to discuss performance, common issues and develop action plans.

• Develop and maintain constructive relationships across three Supply Chain provincial divisions in a “pod” that would include employees from: Sourcing & Contracts, Purchase Operations, and Supplier Relationship Management divisions, and work within these pods to identify efficiencies that could impact Supply Chain’s services to its customers, and commodities being ordered and delivered, including making recommendations to improve supplier performance, manage the legal landscape impacting procurement, and provide increased bid opportunities.

• Manage supplier and product complaints and use business acumen to recognize issues, analyze options and recommend course of action to work complaint to resolution.

• Analyze internal and third-party data to identify risks related to supply chain sustainability including potential disruptions in the current and projected future supply chain, and monitor threats to supply availability and NLHS operations.

• Evaluate and promote Environmental Social Governance (ESG) initiatives in NLHS in relation to supply chain and SRM including collaborating with suppliers to implement sustainable practices and monitor their progress, and promote diversity and inclusion within the supply chain;

• Promote the Supplier Relationship Management function and associated customer/end user satisfaction goals internally.

• Interpret and communicate Supply Chain policies and procedures and provincial legislation and works with end users to provide advice and ensure compliance.

• Assist with the management and coordination of product recalls, warranties and supplier complaints.

• Complete special projects as required.

## Required qualifications:

*A satisfactory record of work performance and attendance is required for this position.
*A satisfactory certificate of conduct from the RCMP or local police authority.
* Graduation from an approved college or university with an Undergraduate Degree in Commerce or Business Administration.
* Strong business and legal acumen to build, deliver and maintain strategic supplier relations and support fiscal stewardship on behalf of NLHS.
* Experience working in pods supporting complex purchasing/supply chain environment, where analytics, projects, and relationship management is integral to
success.
* Minimum 2 years experience in managing suppliers, leading difficult conversations, navigating amongst multiple parties with differing perspectives, decision making, and project management.
* Minimum 2 years specific supply chain experience in: business and supply chain strategy; contract and formal legal document writing and management, supplier engagement, performance monitoring, execution management; supplier relationship management, and risk management.
* Experience in working within the ESG space particularly in monitoring impacts on supplier relationships.
* Very proficient in preparing electronic reports, analysis, data management, and communications.
* Strong writing and formatting skills to develop, proof-read, edit, and format legally binding content is required. And, must have the ability to communicate, both orally and written, with internal customers, departments, vendors, and other external stakeholders such as Public Procurement Agency and legal counsel to ensure there is a clear understanding of the requirements.
* A range of interpersonal skills are required including: listening to information from others; asking questions to obtain information; providing routine information and direction to others; communicating complex information; handling difficult/contentious situations; negotiating contracts and agreements; gaining the cooperation of others to complete work tasks and providing expert advice/counselling.
* Exhibit leadership skills in each of the Leads domains: leads self, engage others, achieve results, develop coalitions, and systems thinking; customer relations, conflict management, planning, and organizing.

## Preferred qualifications:

* A designation in one of the supply chain professional streams (CSCP, CPIM, CPSM, SCMP or related designation).
* Has exhibited integrity, creativity, commitment to continuous learning, effective communications, interpersonal skills, integrative systems thinking, and awareness of the needs of others.
* Knowledge and/or experience with process and quality improvement techniques including: Lean, Six Sigma, Performance Management, Total Quality Management, etc.

Job Summary
Registered Nurses in Long Term Care lead, coordinate and participate in the delivery of holistic and supportive care to residents by assessing, developing, implementing, and evaluating the plan of care. This may include the provision of health promotion, curative, supportive, rehabilitative, and palliative services. They also provide professional supervision and direction to the nursing care team while supporting other members of the interprofessional team to achieve safe and effective care of residents. They ensure that documentation and nursing policies and practices are followed, and they work together with families to ensure the highest standard of resident-centered care is provided.

Long Term Care settings are often complex. Residents have diverse needs resulting from such conditions as chronic illness and functional and cognitive impairments. This population includes frail or elderly adults, individuals with physical and intellectual disabilities and/or individuals with mental illness. The work environment is fast paced where contact with the public, residents and other health professionals are the norm. The Nurse will function with considerable independence and may also be the initial ‘on site’ contact to address issues related to residents, staff and building safety after hours and on the weekends.

Job Demands
By applying for this job, you acknowledge an understanding that regular requirements and demands of this job include (but are not limited to):
Constantly moves/lifts up to 10 lbs., regularly moves/lifts up to 25 lbs. and occasionally is required to restrain/reposition/move/lift up to 30 lbs. Pushes/pulls up to medium force.
Constantly stands/walks and works in awkward or cramped positions to assist with procedures.
Constantly uses fine finger/precision, auditory, sensory, and visual concentration to provide and conduct risk assessments, observe/monitor patients, to complete documents, follow directions, administer medications, etc.
May be subject to time pressures/deadlines and subject to lack of control over work pace.

Job Qualifications
Graduation from an approved/recognized school of nursing program is required. A Bachelor of Nursing Degree would be an asset.
Current and continuing practicing licensure as a Registered Nurse with the Newfoundland and Labrador College of Nurses.
Current BLS for Health Care Providers certification is required.
Successful completion of a recognized Post-Basic Gerontology Program, Canadian Nurses Association Certification in Gerontological Nursing, Advanced Foot Care course, and Leadership courses would be considered assets.
Previous experience caring for geriatric populations including those with dementia and as well as those with intellectual and physical disabilities would be an asset.
Knowledgeable of seniors’ issues and support best practice in gerontological care.
Ability to deal effectively with end-of-life issues.
Demonstrated ability to lead a unit in the provision of quality nursing care and to be an advocate for the philosophy of resident centered care.
Demonstrated strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain effective relationships with residents and their families.
Demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills.
A satisfactory record of work performance is required.

Please note that job offers will be made in accordance with Article 23.12 of the RNUNL Collective Agreement.

## Job Summary

The position of Medical Communications Officer (MCO) works within the Medical Communications Centre (MCC) with accountability to ensure coordination and balanced ambulance coverage to all communities within the designated coverage area. The MCO provides rapid response to requests for Routine, Emergency, and Non-Emergent Ambulance service, as well as coordinating the Flight Team and the Provincial Air Ambulance program. The MCO will work independently under the policies and guidelines of NLHS, reporting directly to the Operations Supervisor.

## Job Demands

By applying for this job, you acknowledge an understanding that regular requirements and demands of this job include (but are not limited to):

• Occasionally lifts or moves objects weighing less than 25 lbs.

• Regularly required to sit at a work station for extended periods of time.

• Constantly uses fine finger precision work while working on a computer.

• Auditory demands include multiple phone lines ringing, listening for radio transmissions from ambulances, which have to be time stamped and entered into the computer, and background talking from other dispatchers and staff.

• Alertness and concentration are required when performing emergency medical dispatch work. Higher than normal levels of attentiveness or alertness for the health and safety of others is required at all times.

• Time pressures, interruptions, deadlines and lack of control over work pace are experienced when dealing with medical emergency dispatching and responding to 911 calls, listening to radio transmissions from ambulances and entering information into the computer.

## Job Qualifications

• Completion of an Emergency Medical Dispatcher (EMD) certificate with the International Academy of Emergency Medical Dispatchers (IAED) is required and must be valid when applying.?

• Completion of a recognized/approved Standard First Aid and BLS - CPR certification is required and must be valid when applying.?

• Completion of a recognized/approved Medical Terminology course is required*

• Successful completion of CritiCall aptitude testing is required. Testing will be administered by the Human Resources.?

• Computer literacy in a Windows environment with strong comprehensive computer skills required. A Windows skills test score of 70% is required. A Windows skills test will be administered by Human Resources.

• Knowledge of the geography of the province of Newfoundland Labrador, including major streets, highways, communities, regions, hospitals, and primary medical facilities, is required.?

• Knowledge of Microsoft Windows in a multi-screen computer environment is required.

• Demonstrated ability and dexterity in handling call-taking and dispatching functions using computer aided - dispatch, multi-line telephone, and radio communications systems is required.

• Demonstrated ability to define and carry out priorities as identified.

• Demonstrated ability work efficiently and effectively in a multi-tasking high stress environment is required.

• Demonstrated sound and rapid decision-making ability under stressful conditions is required.

• Demonstrated effective interpersonal communications and customer service skills to deal with the public and co-workers is required.

• Demonstrated strong critical thinking, decision making and problem-solving skills is required.

• Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively in English is required.

• A satisfactory record of work performance and attendance is required.

*If medical terminology isn't current, a medical terminology test may be administered by the Human Resources Client Services Department.

description:
## About NLHC

The Newfoundland and Labrador Housing Corporation (NL Housing) is a crown corporation whose mandate is to develop and administer housing assistance policy and programs for the benefit of low to moderate income households throughout the province. As the largest landlord in the Province, NL Housing manages a portfolio of over 5,500 units province-wide. The services provided by NL Housing provide clients with access to safe, stable and affordable housing, which is essential to the social, financial, and physical well-being of individuals, families and communities. There is a wide range of housing needs across the province, from those facing homelessness or at risk of homelessness, to low income households needing assistance to pay rent or complete much-needed repairs on their homes. For more information on our programs and services, and strategic priorities, please visit our website www.nlhc.nl.ca.

## About the Department/Region

Context: The Eastern Region maintains and supports approximately 3,500 NL Housing rental properties on the Avalon and Burin Peninsulas through offices in St. John's (Avalon) and Marystown. The region provides a wide range of services, including receiving and processing rental applications; administering rental accounts and lease compliance provisions; providing various client services and tenant relations including eviction prevention, and monitoring, facilitating and administering property maintenance. A variety of programs designed to support low to moderate income households and homeowners are also delivered. Regional staff members are involved in the delivery of the Provincial Home Repair, Home Modification, Home Energy Savings, Partner Managed Housing, and Rent Supplement Programs.

## Position Details

Competition Number: 2026/27-045-700530P

Employment Type: 1 Permanent Position

Department/Region: Eastern Region

Location: Avalon Regional Maintenance, St. John's

Posting Status: Internal/External

Closing Date: October 13th, 2026

Salary Scale: $57,428 to $63,793 per annum (CG-29, $27.61 to $30.67 per hour), 40-hour work week

Duties:

The incumbent is responsible for installing, repairing, and maintaining oil-burning heating systems in both occupied and vacant residential properties. This includes working with components such as thermostats, motors, piping, safety devices, fuel supply connections, ventilation, and electrical systems, all in compliance with applicable codes and environmental protection requirements. Duties involve reviewing and interpreting blueprints and specifications to determine work requirements and system layout; identifying necessary tools, materials, and equipment; and assembling system components using hand and power tools, including measuring, cutting, threading, and soldering. The role also includes marking component locations, cutting openings through walls and floors, installing supports and hangers, testing systems for proper operation, adjusting controls, troubleshooting malfunctions, and performing scheduled maintenance. The incumbent is expected to maintain daily records of materials and labour, operate a corporate van, and perform other related duties, including plumbing.

## Screening Criteria

Experience in installing, maintaining and repairing oil-burning heating systems in residential properties

## Assessment Criteria

Knowledge of oil heating system components

Ability to maintain accurate records

Ability to operate a computer to prepare documents or access databases.

Ability to read blueprints, drawings and sketches

Ability to effectively exchange information

Ability to manage time and tasks while working independently

Relationship building

Professionalism

Conditions of Acceptance

Willing to accept day travel (significant)

Willing to accept overnight travel (occasional)

title: Bilingual Marketing and Communications Coordinator (Bilingual French and English)
description:
Bilingual Marketing and Communications Coordinator (Bilingual French and English)

Location: Fredericton
Job Type: Full-time Hybrid/Remote with Regional Travel

## About Us

Behind every person living with Alzheimer's disease and other dementias, there are hundreds of people dedi-cated to helping them. The Alzheimer Society is the leading not-for-profit health organization working nation-wide to improve the quality of life for Canadians affected by Alzheimer's disease and other dementias while ad-vancing the search for a cause and cure. Since 1987, the Alzheimer Society of New Brunswick (ASNB) has been committed to supporting individuals living with dementia, their families, care partners, healthcare profession-als, and communities through education, advocacy, and support.

## Job Summary

As a Marketing and Communications Coordinator, you will play a key role in strengthening the Alzheimer Soci-ety of New Brunswick's brand presence, awareness initiatives, fundraising campaigns, and community engage-ment efforts throughout the province. Reporting to the Manager of Brand and Philanthropy, you will support the development and execution of strategic marketing and communications activities across multiple platforms.

Working collaboratively with all departments, you will create compelling bilingual content, manage digital com-munications channels, support media relations and marketing campaigns, and help share the impact of ASNB's work with donors, volunteers, care partners, healthcare professionals, and the broader community.

## Distinguishing Characteristics

The ideal candidate is a creative and detail-oriented communications professional who is passionate about storytelling, community impact, and mission-driven work. They are an exceptional writer and communicator in both English and French and have experience creating engaging content for a variety of digital and print platforms.

The successful candidate demonstrates initiative, adaptability, strong organizational skills, and sound judgment. They are comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously, analyzing marketing performance metrics, working collaboratively across departments, and representing the Alzheimer Society of New Brunswick in a pro-fessional and positive manner.

## Typical Duties and Responsibilities

## Marketing and Communications

• Support the development, implementation, and evaluation of internal and external marketing and com-munications activities aligned with ASNB's strategic priorities.

• Contribute to annual communications and marketing plans that increase awareness, engagement, fund-raising success, and brand recognition.

• Create compelling bilingual (English/French) content and graphics for a variety of platforms, including:
• Social media

• Website

• Email marketing and newsletters

• Advertisements

• Press releases

• Promotional materials

• Donor and stewardship communications

• Event and campaign materials

• Maintain and update website content, including landing pages, event information, and key program re-sources to ensure accuracy, accessibility, and alignment with brand standards.

• Monitor and analyze website performance metrics and provide recommendations for optimization and improvement.

• Manage social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube, with responsibil-ity for content planning and scheduling, graphic creation, community engagement, monitoring mes-sages, comments, and mentions, performance tracking and reporting.

• Monitor and analyze social media metrics such as reach, engagement, impressions, clicks, shares, and audience growth.

• Coordinate the production of marketing collateral and branded materials in collaboration with internal teams and external vendors.

• Assist in the promotion of programs, services, events, fundraising campaigns, awareness initiatives, and advocacy activities.

• Co-lead one of ASNB's IG Wealth Management Walk for Alzheimer's volunteer organizing committees.

• Collaborate with staff across departments to gather impact stories, client experiences, program out-comes, and organizational updates for external communications.

• Support media relations activities through the development of press releases, media materials, media lists, and coverage tracking.

• Monitor emerging issues, trends, and reputational risks that may affect communications activities and recommend appropriate responses.

• Support internal communications initiatives that promote organizational alignment, information sharing, and employee engagement.

• Ensure brand consistency and compliance across all communications and marketing activities.

## Administration and Professional Development

• Assist with reporting, data entry, administrative tasks, and other duties that contribute to organizational success.

• Support donor stewardship and fund development activities through the identification of potential do-nors, volunteers, community partners, and corporate supporters.

• Participate in provincial and national initiatives as required, including collaboration with Federation part-ners and national working groups.

• Collaborate with the Executive Director and team members to ensure person-centred approaches are reflected throughout organizational activities.

• Foster a culture of philanthropy by supporting awareness, engagement, and fundraising efforts across the organization.

• Participate in ongoing professional development opportunities and stay informed of emerging trends and best practices in marketing, communications, and nonprofit engagement.

• Travel throughout New Brunswick as required.

## Qualifications

• Must be fully bilingual in English and French.

• Post-secondary education in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Digital Media, or a related field.

• Minimum one years of experience in marketing, communications, public relations, journalism, digital marketing, or a related field.

• Experience working within the nonprofit, healthcare, community service, or charitable sector is consid-ered an asset.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and French.

• Strong storytelling abilities with experience creating content that engages diverse audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to adapt messaging, tone, and content for different communication channels and audiences.

• Experience managing social media platforms and creating engaging digital content.

• Proficiency with Canva or similar graphic design platforms and basic video editing software.

• Experience using marketing and communications tools, including: Meta Business Suite, Mailerlite or sim-ilar email marketing platforms, website content management systems such as Drupal, analytics and re-porting tools.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and online collaboration tools.

• Demonstrated commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion.

• Sensitive to the impact of dementia on individuals, families, and care partners.

• Strong interpersonal skills with a positive, collaborative, and professional approach.

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team.

• Valid New Brunswick driver's license with the ability to travel throughout the province.

• Ability to work occasional evenings and weekends to support events, campaigns, and organizational ac-tivities.

• Criminal Record Check and Vulnerable Sector Check required.

## What We Offer

• A supportive, mission-aligned team environment.

• Collaborative culture.

• Opportunities for professional learning and career development.

• Comprehensive benefits package including health and dental coverage, wellness initiatives, paid time off, and retirement contributions.

• Mileage and travel reimbursement for approved travel.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Financial Analyst

Work Location: 6080 Young Street, Halifax, NS (On-site, 5 days per week)

Department: Finance & Corporate Services

Reports To: Accounting Manager

Employment Status: Full time, 40 hours per week

At Eastlink, Financial Analysts are driven by curiosity, accuracy, and the opportunity to help the business make informed decisions. By analyzing financial results, identifying trends, and providing meaningful insights, they play an important role in supporting operational performance and business success.

In this role, you'll support a variety of operating departments by providing financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and analysis. Working closely with Accounting and business partners, you'll help ensure financial information is accurate, actionable, and supports effective decision-making.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Financial Analyst, you'll help provide the financial insights that support planning and performance across the organization. Your responsibilities will include:

• Preparing monthly financial reports, variance analysis, and commentary on departmental operating expenses.

• Supporting the development of annual budgets, monthly forecasts, and long-range financial projections.

• Partnering with business leaders to review financial results and forecast assumptions.

• Preparing expense allocations, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Analyzing financial performance, investigating variances, and identifying trends and opportunities.

• Providing reporting and ad hoc analysis to support business and operational decisions.

• Contributing to process improvements that enhance the accuracy and efficiency of financial reporting.

What We’re Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with numbers, solving problems, and understanding the story behind the financial results. You'll succeed in this role if you:

• Have strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.

• Are detail-oriented and enjoy digging into data to understand variances and trends.

• Can manage multiple priorities and consistently meet deadlines.

• Communicate effectively and build strong working relationships across teams.

• Take initiative and look for opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.

• Are committed to continuous learning and expanding your business knowledge.

You’ll Also Bring

• A Bachelor of Commerce degree with a focus in Accounting.

• Three to five years of experience in an accounting or financial analysis role.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong spreadsheet skills.

• Experience preparing financial reports, budgets, forecasts, and account reconciliations.

• Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time management skills.

• Enrollment in a professional accounting designation program is considered an asset.

• A collaborative approach and commitment to contributing to a positive team environment.

About Eastlink

Eastlink is proudly family-owned and headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia. After more than 50 years, we’ve grown from a small-town startup into one of Canada’s Best Managed companies without losing our entrepreneurial edge. We move fast. We try new things. We care about doing right by our customers, and we’re not afraid to take a different approach to make that happen.

Why Work with Us

We could say we’re not your typical telecom, but what makes us different is how we operate day to day. At Eastlink, we’re a tight-knit team all working toward common goals. We’re big enough to do meaningful work, but small enough that you can actually make your mark. You won’t get stuck waiting for layers of approval or years of tenure to make an impact! We believe in getting involved, speaking up, and figuring things out together. We’re always listening, learning, and adapting because our customers (and our people) expect us to. And just like we invest in our network, we invest in you, with intention and for the long run.

When you join Eastlink, you'll enjoy:

• Opportunities for internal growth and promotion

• Paid vacation and holidays

• Comprehensive health and dental benefits

• Company pension plan with employer contributions

• Employee discounts on Eastlink products and services

We’re committed to building a workplace where everyone feels they belong. We embrace diversity, inclusion, equity, and accessibility throughout all levels of the organization and encourage members of equity groups to self-identify during the application process. Need an accommodation during the hiring process? We encourage you to reach out and let us know how we can support your participation.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
Scotian Gold Co-operative Limited is a food industry leader with an established international reputation for high-quality produce. Our operations include Eastern Canada's largest apple packing and storage operation, an agricultural division, and a retail division. Scotian Gold is committed to excellence, respect for people, families and communities. We are always looking for energetic and talented people ready to take on new challenges! Visit our Web site at www.scotiangold.com.

Scotian Gold is looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our team. Reporting to the VP Sales & Marketing, the Sales Coordinator is responsible for providing professional customer service and supporting the sales process from order entry through to the customer receiving the product.
