title: Supervisor, Maintenance
description:
Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is growing?

## Who We Are

We are a global mining company dedicated to safely delivering nickel, copper, cobalt, and platinum group metals essential for the world's energy transition.

Our mission is to improve lives and shape a better future together.

From utensils to cellphones to satellites, our operations simplify daily life and enhance connectivity. Our metals are integral to life-saving medical equipment and the electric vehicles driving the fight against climate change – our work truly matters.

Join our diverse team of 15,000 talented individuals committed to transforming critical minerals into prosperity and sustainable development in countries like Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, and Japan. We invite you to use your skills with us and contribute to something meaningful and enduring.

## The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Supervisor, Maintenance (Mobile) to join our Copper Cliff South Mine team in Sudbury, Ontario.

This is a permanent onsite position. The work schedule is days/nights on a 5/4 rotation.

As a Supervisor, Maintenance (Mobile) you will be accountable for continuously improving the work team performance through the effective use of established processes and procedures at South Mine. Your experience and skills will establish and maintain work relationships with the various key plant stakeholders including supervisors, planners, schedulers, superintendents, crew members, etc.

Additionally, in this position you will:

• Adhere to maintenance business processes as outlined in Maintenance Planning and Control (MPC) by using approved systems (SAP, Prometheus, etc.), tools, and standards.

• Review and promote/reject all new Urgent notifications in your work center through the group approval process.

• Ensure planned work orders are closed with proper time confirmations completed. Identify and escalate all critical issues that threaten the successful execution of work orders for completion by their Required End Date.

• Monitor KPIs and actively strive toward plant targets.

• Work within assigned budgets and escalate to management should a budget be exceeded.

• Establish and maintain work relationships with the various key plant stakeholders including supervisors, planners, schedulers, superintendents, crew members, etc.

• Follow safe work practices and guidelines, ESA, OSHA, Vale Standards.

• Follow the CBA to ensure that we meet or exceed requirements negotiated with the union

## About You

## Education:

• Grade 12 completed or GED equivalency with equivalent experience is required.

• College diploma or university degree in a related industrial field or a university degree in a related engineering discipline.

• Valid industrial trade certificate for the province of Ontario (HDET Red Seal Certificate of Qualification 421A).

• Generic Supervisor Common Core (770141).

## Experience:

• Minimum 3 years of experience in the HDET trade is required.

• Minimum 1 years of experience supervising and leading teams with best work practices.

• Experience in a mining plant or heavy industry is an asset.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Products, SAP, and Prometheus add-on.

## Skills:

• Ability to work with minimal supervision and work well with others in a team environment.

• Written and oral communication skills.

• Must be obsessed with safety and risk.

• Demonstrate open and transparent dialogue in all aspects of work.

## What We Offer You

• Competitive compensation including a variable annual incentive plan

• Participation in a competitive Defined Contribution Pension package

• Comprehensive benefits package (company paid core coverage, health and dental coverage, flex accounts, disability plans and optional insurances)

• Leave for all of life's reasons (vacation, flex, sick, parental)

• Work culture dedicated to safety, diversity & inclusion, and career growth

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Virtual Healthcare online

• Online training and career development opportunities

## Why Sudbury

Greater Sudbury is a vibrant city in northeastern Ontario, renowned for its rich mining history and significant role in Canada's mineral production. The city sits atop one of the world's largest and oldest meteorite impact sites, the Sudbury Basin, which is exceptionally rich in nickel, copper, and other critical minerals that are needed for the green economy. The mining sector is a cornerstone of Sudbury's economy, driving both employment and economic growth, and Vale Base Metals plays a pivotal role in this regard. Our commitment to the community is as deep as our mines.

## Include to Transform

At Vale Base Metals, we are committed to ensuring an inclusive work environment where people feel comfortable to be themselves. Vale encourages everyone to express their ideas and opinions and values the plurality of individual profiles. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are critical to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or any other personal consideration that makes us different.

Vale is an equal opportunity employer seeking to increase diversity across our operations and improve equal opportunity at Vale and in the mining industry.

In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, accommodation is available throughout our recruitment process for applicants with disabilities.

Pay Grade: 17V

Base Salary: $108,000

Apply by: October 15, 2026

## #ValeBaseMetals

Interested applicants must submit their application online at https://vale.eightfold.ai/careers

The Birches Nursing Home in Musquodoboit Harbour, NS, Canada
Facility: The Birches Nursing Home
Location: 7702 HWY 7, Musquodoboit Harbour, Nova Scotia
Job Category: Nursing, Healthcare
Position Available: Permanent Full-Time

## Facility Description:

As a Community Governed Organization and part of the Musquodoboit Harbour community since 1979, The Birches is home to 42 long term care residents who benefit from our focus on resident-centered care and honouring each person's lifelong routine.

This is made possible through the dedication of fantastic staff from a variety of disciplines, including nursing, continuing care assistants, recreation, maintenance, food services, laundry, housekeeping, and administrative support. Active volunteers also complement our day-to-day work. The Birches is committed to the highest standards of support and services and promotes a health workplace for its 100 staff. The organization fosters a healthy work life balance and uses the latest best practice information at all levels.

The Recreation Programmer is responsible for planning, implementing and evaluating leisure/ therapeutic recreation on an individual basis and/or group program. The Recreation Programmer must demonstrate an understanding of the cognitive, physical, emotional, intellectual, spiritual and psycho-social benefits that therapeutic recreation provides in maintaining and/or enhancing the quality of life for residents.

• A post-secondary degree in Recreation/Leisure Studies OR a two (2) year community college diploma in Recreation. Preference given to those with bachelor's degree in Therapeutic Recreation and certification with NCTRC.

• Gerontology Certificate an asset.

• Minimum one year work experience in providing leadership in recreation planning and implementing of programs in a long-term care setting an asset.

• An active membership with the Nova Scotia Therapeutic Recreation Association and keep with current new programming approaches and trends in the field is an asset.

• Comprehensive Benefits Package

• Comprehensive Orientation

• We innovate always and everywhere.

## OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to support a complex Pension Transformation initiative on a short-term client project, with an immediate start preferred. This role will work across business, operations, finance, compliance, technology, and external vendors to bring structure and clarity to a highly complex transformation environment

The ideal candidate will bring strong senior-level transformation experience, with direct pensions experience highly preferred. Experience with pension administration, pension operations, pension platform migration/replacement, recordkeeping transformation, or pension administration outsourcing would be particularly relevant. Strong Financial Services or Insurance transformation experience may also be considered.

• Map and validate current-state and future-state business processes, including roles, handoffs, dependencies, controls, and process gaps.

• Facilitate working sessions with business stakeholders, SMEs, project teams, technology teams, and external vendors to clarify requirements and drive decisions.

• Support data migration, system integration, reconciliation, testing/UAT, and operational readiness activities.

• Work across business and technology teams to ensure requirements are understood, validated, and aligned throughout the transformation lifecycle.

• Identify and escalate risks, dependencies, requirement gaps, and outstanding decisions that could impact the program critical path or go-live.

• Bring structure to ambiguous or incomplete requirements and independently drive analysis through to resolution.

## WHAT SKILLS / QUALIFICATIONS YOU LL NEED TO DO THE JOB:

• Senior Business Analyst experience supporting complex transformation programs.

• Strong experience with business process mapping, requirements elicitation, requirements documentation, and stakeholder facilitation.

• Experience supporting data migration, integrations, testing/UAT, reconciliation, and requirements traceability.

• Strong preference for pensions experience, particularly within pension administration, pension operations, or pension transformation.

• Experience with pension administration outsourcing, pension platform migration/replacement, or recordkeeping transformation is highly desirable.

• Strong Financial Services or Insurance transformation experience may be considered where direct pensions experience is limited.

• Experience working within regulated or highly controlled environments.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively across business, finance, operations, compliance, technology, and external vendor teams.

• Strong facilitation and decision-support skills, with the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.

• Ability to work independently, learn quickly, and bring structure and clarity to ambiguous or incomplete requirements.

## AND YOU ARE...

• Always improving your skills and knowledge: you want to be the best at what you do

• Curious and creative; comfortable taking on new problems and challenges

• A self-starter with the ability to recommend priorities to the project leader

• Comfortable working through problems and figuring things out with minimal supervision

• Great problem-solving skills: thorough and reliable

• Able to work in a team: share knowledge and assist other team members

• A good communicator: able to explain your ideas and recommendations

• Well organized and dependable under pressure: you manage your time effectively

• Energized by our company values!

## WHY MARINER?

We believe in making a positive impact in the communities where we live and work! Not only are we passionate about nurturing a thriving technology sector here in Atlantic Canada, but we are also committed to solving technology challenges that will make an impact worldwide. Technology is everlasting, and we take pride in connecting world class talent to world class projects and business solutions.

If you are an IT Professional, Software Professional, or Management Consultant, that is passionate about career development, data, and problem solving, we want to hear from you! If this sounds like someone you know, share this with them so they do not miss the opportunity to experience Mariner!

To achieve this, we know we need to be all in on training and development of our team so we can continue to move the needle in the technology sector together. Of course, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to our team, but our competitive edge is the development and training that our team experiences every day.

Be part of our vibrant community that values diversity and embraces inclusion at every level. We are committed to fostering a culture where individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life feel empowered to contribute their unique perspectives. Our collaborative environment celebrates the richness of ideas and experiences, and we believe that by embracing diversity, we can achieve greater innovation and excellence together. Come and help us create a workplace that reflects the beautiful tapestry of our global community.

Interested in making a difference in our province? We encourage you to Choose GNB!

## Who we are

The work we do has a positive impact on our communities, and helps improve the everyday lives of New Brunswickers. Together, we are over 45,000 New Brunswickers who are passionate problem-solvers, who make a difference and are proud to call New Brunswick home.

The Department of Justice and Public Safety is dedicated to the rule of law, the promotion of the public interest, and the impartial administration of justice and works to improve the safety, security and resiliency of communities and citizens.

The Attorney General is the law officer of the Executive Council and is responsible to see that the administration of public affairs is in accordance with the law and to ensure protection of the public interest. The Legal Services Branch provides civil and constitutional legal advice and representation to all provincial government departments and related agencies.

The Office of the Attorney General is seeking an individual to join the Legal Services Branch as a Lawyer 1 or 2 within the Constitutional Law Group.

The successful candidate will be assigned to the Constitutional Law Group and will work with other lawyers in a team setting and be responsible for conducting constitutional litigation and/or working with lawyers from the Litigation Group in constitutional litigation matters, appearing in all levels of courts and before administrative boards and tribunals throughout the province. The successful candidate will also be responsible for providing legal advice and opinions with respect to Memorandums to Executive Council, and other legal issues related to constitutional/Charter and indigenous law related matters.

As a team player, you will possess strong interpersonal and communication skills.

Your attitude, skills and interests are just as important as your area of study. We are looking for diverse backgrounds that bring a combination of the following:

• Membership in good standing or eligibility for membership in good standing with the Law Society of New Brunswick;

• Minimum of 8 years at the bar for Lawyer 2 positions, and a minimum of 4 years at the bar for the Lawyer 1 position;

• Recent experience in litigation commensurate with the candidate's years at the Bar, including experience conducting hearings before any level of court, boards or tribunals;

• Demonstrated interest in Indigenous law, and a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development in this area;

• Effective interactive communication,

• Initiative, self-control/stamina,

• Commitment to learning, and

• Teamwork and cooperation.

title: Electrical Drafting Technologist
description:
At CBCL Limited, we are a successful, dynamic, and growing engineering and environmental consulting firm. As a leader in renewable energy integration in the Atlantic region, we have many exciting projects forecasted in the coming years. With the growth of our service offerings, we are seeking enthusiastic individuals who want to contribute to the expansion of clean energy and the resulting positive impact on our environment.

We currently have an exciting opportunity for an Electrical Drafting Technologist to join our Electrical Utilities & Renewables design team in our Halifax, Nova Scotia office. Bring your passion and skills to a collaborative team that thrives on delivering innovative solutions for our clients in the electrical utilities and renewable energy sectors. You'll play a pivotal role in advancing clean energy initiatives that power our communities and contribute to a more sustainable future.

All experience levels are encouraged to apply! Whether you're just starting your career or you're a seasoned professional, this is an opportunity to be part of exciting projects and grow alongside a team of skilled engineers and technologists dedicated to making a positive impact.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Contribute to the Future of Clean Energy: Contribute to the drafting design of electrical systems, including power transmission and distribution, substation layouts, protection and control systems, and SCADA systems;

• Craft with Precision: Perform accurate and detailed drafting work, including drawings, specifications, and technical documentation using AutoCAD and Revit for both 2D drafting and 3D modelling;

• Collaborate and Innovate: Work with senior engineers and multidisciplinary teams to refine design concepts, perform engineering calculations, and ensure project specifications meet client needs and regulatory standards;

• Support Project Success: Prepare technical reports and tender documents.

Your Capabilities and Credentials:

• Educational Background: A diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology is preferred. Candidates with diplomas in CAD-related fields such as Civil or Structural Engineering Technology, Architectural Engineering Technology, Architectural Drafting, or similar programs will also be considered;

• Experience: 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in electrical CAD drafting is preferred, but we are open to candidates with less experience who are eager to learn and grow;

• Technical Expertise: Proficiency in AutoCAD/Civil3D, MicroStation, and Revit, as well as 3D component modelling software with ability to create and edit electrical designs and equipment;

• Team Player: A collaborative mindset to work effectively within a team environment; and

• Organized and Detail-Oriented: Ability to multi-task, manage time effectively, and pay attention to detail through the coordination of complex design packages.

What will Make You Stand Out:

• Previous experience in a consulting engineering environment is highly desirable;

• Certification as a Certified Engineering Technologist (CET) or the ability to become registered is preferred;

• Experience with Autodesk Revit, AGI32 lighting simulation software, and SKM Power*Tools or other electrical simulation software is a plus; and

• Past use of Bluebeam Revu for collaboration and review of drawings is beneficial;

• Experience in graphic design with ability to generate aesthetic drawings is considered a strong asset.

You are welcome to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements.

What we can offer you:

• A competitive compensation package effective on your first day of employment:
• Comprehensive health and dental benefits

• CAAT Defined Benefit Pension Plan with employer contributions

• Generous vacation allowance commensurate with experience

• Maternity or Parental leave top-up

• Health spending account

• Wellness incentive

• Membership dues reimbursement

• Education and lifelong learning subsidization

• Community volunteering incentive

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Public transit subsidy

In addition to the above benefits, we offer:

• Flexible hours and locations to support work/life balance, including hybrid solutions;

• Ability to work paid overtime and bank time-in-lieu for future use;

• Diverse team with a wide range of experience and expertise;

• Exposure to a variety of projects;

• Support to develop skills and pursue projects related to your own interests;

• Collaboration between multiple disciplines and levels of expertise;

• Mentoring opportunities to foster your personal and professional development;

• Accessible and central offices in Atlantic Canada and Ottawa; and

• Access to training opportunities in areas ranging from technical development to leadership skills.

• CBCL is employee-owned, with ownership opportunities available to eligible staff.

About Us

At CBCL our purpose is to create a positive and lasting impact on people and our planet. As an employee-owned firm, at CBCL, our people are everything. We are committed to promoting inclusivity and diversity for a workplace where everyone can thrive, and we build long-term relationships with our clients while providing them with innovative solutions.

We have earned recognition as one of Canada's Top 100 Employers and one of Canada's Best Managed Companies. Our multitalented group of professionals offer consulting in the Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater, Buildings, Industrial, and Earth and Environment sectors. We value our people, our communities, and our history and look forward to continuing our steady growth.

Along with our commitment to reducing our carbon footprint corporately, CBCL develops and implements sustainable engineering solutions that respect the current social and environmental impacts, as well as future implications of our designs.

CBCL operates from its offices in Halifax and Sydney, NS; Charlottetown, PE; Saint John, Fredericton and Moncton, NB; St. John's, NL, and Ottawa, ON.

## ABOUT NL HEALTH SERVICES

We are a provincial health authority responsible for delivering quality health care to approximately 550,000 people in Newfoundland and Labrador. Supported by over 23,000 employees and physicians, our team works together to improve the health and well-being of every person, in every community. Guided by the vision of the Health Accord NL, we offer a range of health-care programs and services through a wide network of facilities, clinics, and community services across five zones: Central, Eastern-Rural, Eastern-Urban, Labrador-Grenfell, and Western.

At NL Health Services, we believe that our people — employees, doctors and volunteers — make it a great place to work. Every individual brings valuable knowledge, experience and perspective. It is in this diversity that we find strength. We are committed to embracing the distinct and complementary characteristics of our members, as we seek to eliminate health disparities, and ensuring we provide fair, equitable and quality health care to everyone.

If you are passionate about making a difference and providing exceptional health care, we want to hear from you. Join our team and be part of something extraordinary.

????????????????????????????????????????

## ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

The Surgical Services Perioperative Program of NL Health Services – Eastern Urban Zone invites applications for a full-time Anesthesiologist at Health Sciences Centre in St. John's, NL, with a start date of November 1, 2026, or sooner if possible.

The successful candidate will join a group of 21 Anesthesiologists at HSC, functioning as key members of the perioperative team responsible for the provision of anesthetic services to surgical patients. The position involve direct involvement in the care of patients pre- and post-operatively, including responsibility for pre-admission anesthesia clinics and post-operative pain management.

Health Sciences Centre runs 14–16 operating rooms per day across the following surgical specialties: General, Cardiac, Neuro-Surgery, Plastic, Orthopedic, Gynecology/Gyne-ONC, Cath Lab, Neuro-Interventional Radiology, Ophthalmology, and Urology. Anesthesiologists also provide support to ECT, Endovascular Treatment of Stroke, and Acute Pain Services.

On-call coverage averages two (2) times per month, with additional second-call coverage for APS, EVT, and second team averaging one to two times per month.

Health Sciences Centre is a teaching hospital affiliated with the Faculty of Medicine at Memorial University of Newfoundland and Labrador, providing opportunities to engage in educational experiences with anesthesia residents and undergraduate medical students.

## Work Environment

St. John's is a vibrant, historic city on the eastern tip of North America, offering a warm and welcoming community, a thriving arts and culture scene, and easy access to the stunning natural landscapes of the Avalon Peninsula — including whale watching, hiking, and some of the most dramatic coastlines in Canada.

• Medical Degree (MD) from a recognized institution

• Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada Certification in Anesthesiology (or passed Canadian exams)

• Fellowship in Adult Critical Care Medicine from a Canadian institution (required)

• Priority given to candidates with recent clinical experience at the HSC site

• Subspecialty fellowship training considered an asset

• Eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Newfoundland and Labrador (www.cpsnl.ca)

• Must satisfy credentialing and privilege requirements of NL Health Services including a satisfactory criminal record check and vulnerable sector check

????????????????????????????????????????

## DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide anesthetic services to surgical patients across a broad range of surgical specialties

• Deliver pre-operative anesthesia clinic services and post-operative pain management

• Provide support to ECT, Endovascular Treatment of Stroke, and Acute Pain Services

• Participate in on-call coverage averaging two (2) times per month plus second-call coverage averaging one to two times per month

• Contribute to teaching and education of anesthesia residents and undergraduate medical students through the Memorial University affiliation

• Support person- and family-centered care; promote patient and worker safety by integrating safety into work practices, identifying risks, and implementing improvements

Occasionally lifts or moves supplies generally not weighing in excess of 25 lbs. and occasional carrying, pushing/pulling and lifting between 25-50 lbs.

Constantly there is a requirement for fine finger and precision work when using needles to extract specimens, and when palpating for veins, when entering data into the computer, and preparing specimen labels.

title: Office Manager, Payroll & Accounting
description:
Office Manager, Payroll & Accounting
Location: Edwardsville, Nova Scotia
Work Arrangement: In person
Position: Full-time, permanent
Salary: $58,000 to $65,000, depending on experience
Reports to: Director of Finance

## The Opportunity

Cape Breton Beverages and Trans-Atlantic Preforms are seeking a careful, dependable and highly organized Office Manager, Payroll & Accounting. This is a role for someone who takes their work seriously and takes pride in getting the details right. You will be responsible for payroll, benefits and pension administration, core accounting processes and day-to-day office administration for both companies. You will also lead a small, established team, currently made up of four administrative support staff.

The role also supports our sister companies, Nova Scotia Spirit Co./Blue Lobster and Annapolis Cider Company, with a second review of payments and transfers, banking and cash management support, and backup coverage when needed. The work follows a well-defined cycle with firm deadlines: regular payroll runs, month-end and year-end accounting, and scheduled government remittances.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will have clear responsibilities, clear lines of approval and the support you need to do the work accurately and well. You will be the trusted point of contact for employees and managers on payroll, benefit and pension questions. You will also work with our external accountants, auditors, financial institutions and benefit providers.

## What You'll Do

## Payroll, Benefits & Pension

• Process payroll accurately and on schedule for employees across both companies.

• Maintain payroll records and process changes related to compensation, deductions, vacation and other payroll matters.

• Prepare payroll reconciliations, source deduction remittances and related reporting.

• Prepare and issue Records of Employment.

• Administer employee benefit and pension plans, including enrolments, changes, terminations and contributions.

• Work directly with benefit and pension providers to resolve issues and ensure accurate administration.

• Answer employee questions on payroll, benefits and pension clearly and accurately.

• Maintain accurate and confidential employee records.

## Accounting & Financial Administration

• Complete assigned month-end accounting processes and procedures.

• Prepare and post recurring and other required journal entries.

• Assist with general ledger reconciliations and account analysis.

• Prepare and submit HST returns and other required government remittances.

• Oversee accounts payable and support other accounting functions as required.

• Prepare financial and administrative reports for management.

• Maintain complete and accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

## Banking & Cash Management

• Oversee company deposits and day-to-day banking activities.

• Review and process EFT transactions, with final approval by finance leadership, in accordance with company procedures.

• Support banking administration and correspondence.

• Ensure banking transactions and records are accurately maintained and reconciled.

• Provide a second review of payments and transfers for Nova Scotia Spirit Co./Blue Lobster and Annapolis Cider Company before they are released, in accordance with company procedures.

• Support the Director of Finance with banking and cash management for Nova Scotia Spirit Co./Blue Lobster and Annapolis Cider Company, including tracking balances and preparing banking information and reports.

## Year-End & Audit

• Support and coordinate the annual year-end accounting and financial reporting process.

• Prepare year-end schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation.

• Work closely with the Director of Finance and external accountants and auditors to provide required information.

• Respond to audit requests and assist in resolving issues identified through the year-end process.

• Support other financial reporting and compliance requirements as needed.

## Team & Office Administration

• Lead a team (currently comprised of four administrative support staff) by example, as the technical expert in payroll and administration, providing clear direction, training and regular feedback.

• Make sure the team's work is completed accurately, on schedule and in line with company procedures.

• Provide administrative support to managers and employees on payroll, benefits and other employment-related matters.

• Coordinate day-to-day administrative requirements and maintain organized company records.

• Keep accounting and administrative procedures documented and up to date, and recommend improvements.

• Assist the Director of Finance with defined projects as needed.

• Provide backup coverage for payroll, accounting and administrative functions at Nova Scotia Spirit Co./Blue Lobster and Annapolis Cider Company when needed, as assigned by the Director of Finance.

## What You Bring

We are looking for someone who is thorough, disciplined and reliable, with strong knowledge of payroll and accounting and a commitment to doing things properly. The ideal candidate will have:

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in payroll, accounting, financial administration or a combination of these areas.

• Hands-on payroll processing experience, with a sound understanding of payroll rules and remittance requirements.

• Experience supervising or leading a small team.

• Experience with month-end accounting processes, reconciliations and financial reporting.

• Experience preparing government remittances, including payroll source deductions and HST.

• Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.

• A methodical, organized approach, with the ability to plan work around recurring deadlines.

• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

• Respect for procedures, controls and confidentiality, and sound judgment about when to ask a question or raise a concern.

• A professional, respectful and factual manner with employees and colleagues.

• The confidence to follow up, uphold standards and see that procedures are followed.

• The ability to work independently within clear guidelines.

Experience with Sage 300 and Paymate is considered an asset. Post-secondary education in accounting, business administration, payroll or a related field is also considered an asset.

## Confidentiality

This position requires signing a confidentiality agreement, and the successful candidate will be subject to a criminal background check. You will have access to financial information, payroll and compensation details, and sensitive personnel and business matters. In a community where many of our employees are neighbours, discretion is not a formality. It is the foundation of the role.

## Why Cape Breton Beverages and Trans-Atlantic Preforms?

• Stability. Cape Breton Beverages has operated in Cape Breton for 77 years under multiple generations of the same family, and Trans-Atlantic Preforms has been manufacturing for more than 35 years.

• Clarity. Clearly defined tasks, duties and reporting relationships, with established procedures and approval processes.

• A professional work environment. We take quality and accuracy seriously, in our products and in how we run our business.

• Accountability. You will be accountable for accurate payroll, records and administration for both companies, with ownership of your area of expertise.

• Training and support. A structured handover, thorough training on our systems and a Director of Finance who is available for direction.

• A consistent schedule. In-person work at our Edwardsville office.

• Compensation. A salary of $58,000 to $65,000, depending on experience, plus health and dental benefits, and pension.

• A long-term home. A role you can grow in as the companies grow, with a team that has deep roots in Cape Breton and a genuine commitment to its employees, customers and community.

## About Us

We are a group of four Nova Scotia companies with a shared ambition: from Nova Scotia to the world. Cape Breton Beverages has been bottling Pepsi products in Cape Breton for 77 years, across multiple generations of the same family. Trans-Atlantic Preforms has manufactured PET preforms for customers across Canada and internationally for more than 35 years. Nova Scotia Spirit Co. produces Blue Lobster spirits and ready-to-drink beverages, now expanding distribution nationally. Annapolis Cider Company is an award-winning craft cidery in the Annapolis Valley, recognized internationally for its cider. Together we employ more than 170 people across the province. We are growing, and we are building the systems and leadership infrastructure to support our next stage of growth.

This position is based with Cape Breton Beverages and Trans-Atlantic Preforms, with defined banking, payment review and backup support responsibilities for Nova Scotia Spirit Co./Blue Lobster and Annapolis Cider Company. At Cape Breton Beverages, we locally produce Pepsi, 7-Up, Schweppes, and Crush soft-drink products and distribute a wide range of other beverages across Cape Breton Island. Cape Breton Beverages also provides Full Service Beverage and Snack vending throughout Cape Breton Island through its subsidiary Downeast Vending.

All of our companies are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture and share the same core values: quality and reliability in everything we produce, disciplined execution, long-term relationships with customers and partners, continuous improvement, and a strong sense of responsibility to our employees and communities. When you work at Cape Breton Beverages and Trans-Atlantic Preforms, you are part of a team that helps make this Island a better place to live through our active support of fundraisers, community organizations and special events in Cape Breton.

## How to Apply

Please submit your resume and cover letter through CareerBeacon. Applications will be reviewed as they are received and this posting will close once the position is filled, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for the next round, Predictive Index assessments, will be contacted.

Cape Breton Beverages and Trans-Atlantic Preforms are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds.

title: Executive Director of Advancement, Rothesay Netherwood School
description:
Rothesay Netherwood School
Rothesay, NB

Rothesay Netherwood School (RNS) is seeking a strategic, relationship-driven leader to serve as its inaugural Executive Director of Advancement. This is a unique opportunity to shape and lead an integrated advancement vision in one of Canada's leading independent schools.

## The Organization

Founded in 1877, Rothesay Netherwood School (RNS) is a co-educational boarding and day school for Grades 6 to 12 that offers unique and exceptional world-class learning experiences in a safe, caring, and inclusive school community. Our mission is to provide a nurturing environment where students are empowered to embrace their individuality while pursuing the greater good.

Located in Rothesay, New Brunswick, we challenge students to be active, compassionate leaders with a global perspective and the determination to make a difference in the world. We are a proud IB World School and a member of Round Square. RNS is a leading independent school with nearly 150 years of experience providing educational excellence for students from Atlantic Canada, across Canada, and around the world. Boarding is an integral part of our school culture, with half of our boarding students coming from outside of Rothesay, half of whom are from countries around the world. We have representation from over 25 countries worldwide on our campus. Our international student population brings learning opportunities and a deep appreciation of heritage, history and languages.

## The Role

Reporting to the Head of School and serving as a member of the Senior Management Team, the Executive Director of Advancement is a newly created role that brings together Development, Enrolment Management, Marketing and Communications, and the Registrar under a unified strategy. This executive will design and lead a comprehensive advancement program aligned with the School's strategic priorities, with a central mandate to drive a $25 million campaign over the next five years. The Executive Director will play a key role in strengthening the School's culture of philanthropy enhancing its market position and building lasting relationships across its community in Canada and globally.

## Key areas of oversight and responsibility are:

Strategic Leadership and Integration - The Executive Director will develop and execute a comprehensive, multi-year advancement strategy that integrates fundraising, enrolment management, and marketing and communications in alignment with the School's strategic priorities. They will collaborate closely with senior leadership and Boards to establish clear goals, performance metrics, and reporting frameworks.

Human Resources Management - The role will provide unified leadership to the advancement portfolio, fostering a highly collaborative, high-performing team culture while overseeing resources to ensure strong return on investment and long-term institutional sustainability.

Campaign Leadership and Philanthropy - The Executive Director will personally cultivate, solicit, and steward a portfolio of major and transformational donors, while working closely with the Head of School to advance high-level philanthropic relationships. They will strengthen a Culture of Philanthropy across the School community and ensure the continued growth of major gifts, legacy giving, and endowment programs that support the School's long-term vision.

Enrolment Management and Market Positioning - Working in close partnership with the enrolment and marketing teams, the Executive Director will support strategies to enhance student recruitment and retention across domestic and international markets. The role will leverage data, demographic trends, and market insights to refine the School's value proposition, inform financial assistance strategies, and ensure a competitive and differentiated position in the independent school landscape.

## The Ideal Candidate

As the ideal candidate, you are a strategic and relationship-driven leader with a proven ability to advance institutional priorities through fundraising, communications, and team leadership. You bring experience cultivating major gifts and leading ambitious campaigns, with a strong commitment to growing the endowment as a means of expanding access, strengthening financial sustainability, and enabling the School's long-term vision. As an exceptional communicator and storyteller, you articulate a compelling case for support and engage alumni, families, and donors in meaningful ways.

You thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional environment and are skilled at aligning teams around shared goals while fostering a high-performing, accountable, and supportive culture. Both visionary and pragmatic, you are comfortable using data and insight to inform decisions, while also challenging assumptions and introducing new approaches. Above all, you are aligned with the School's mission and energized by the opportunity to position it for continued success, inspiring others to rally behind a clear and ambitious path forward.

## Qualifications and Experience

While the Search Committee recognizes that no one candidate is likely to meet all qualifications in equal measure, those listed below are desirable and will be used to compare candidates.

• A graduate degree in a relevant field (e.g., business, communications, education, or a related discipline) or an equivalent combination of education and senior leadership experience.

• Significant progressive leadership experience in advancement, fundraising, or a related field, ideally within an independent school, post-secondary, or not-for-profit environment.

• Demonstrated success leading or contributing to major fundraising initiatives, including capital campaigns and major gift programs.

• Proven ability to cultivate, solicit, and steward major and transformational donors, with experience supporting senior leaders in high-level philanthropic engagement.

• Experience developing and executing strategies to grow and sustain endowments and build a strong culture of philanthropy.

• Track record of leading integrated or multi-functional teams, with the ability to align advancement, enrolment, and communications efforts around shared priorities.

• Strong people leadership skills, including building high-performing teams, setting clear expectations, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

• Experience working with Boards or governing bodies, with the ability to build trust and support effective governance and engagement.

• Data-informed and strategic mindset, with experience using metrics, CRM systems, and analytics to guide decision-making and measure impact.

## Attributes

• High level of judgment, professionalism, and discretion, with the ability to operate effectively in a senior leadership environment.

• Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to be persuasive while speaking to different audiences.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and articulate a compelling institutional narrative to diverse audiences.

• The ability to work collegially and effectively and build trusting relationships both internally and externally.

Rothesay Netherwood School is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment where all members of our community feel valued, respected, and supported. We welcome applications from diverse backgrounds and are dedicated to a fair hiring process, free from discrimination based on race, ethnicity, age, gender, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We will provide support and accommodations to applicants with disabilities, upon request. If you need accommodation in order to participate as a candidate in the recruitment process, please contact accommodate@kbrs.ca or communicate your needs to the recruitment professional named in the job description.

If you are interested in this opportunity, contact Abbey MacLeod at amacleod@kbrs.ca, Kyle Steele at ksteele@kbrs.ca, or Dr. Jennie Massey at jmassey@kbrs.ca, or submit your full application package online at: Executive Director of Advancement | KBRS

title: Business Architect
description:
## WHO WE ARE:

Mariner innovates always and everywhere, turning novel ideas into practical solutions. From products and services to venture creation, we build better futures powered by people. We partner with people embracing change, leveraging data, cybersecurity, cloud, and change management to drive successful business outcomes that matter to our customers.

Mariners build for change. Like SHIFT Energy, our energy management and decarbonization company. Or East Valley, created to scale social economic impact in our communities through investment and mentorship of emerging change-makers and their companies.

Mariner s purpose has always been to be a great, everlasting technology company and the core values that guide us every day are:

## OUR VALUES

• We care for our team.

• We care about the impact we have on our community.

• We serve by solving complex problems.

• We grow because growth fuels opportunities.

• We innovate always and everywhere.

• We build a business that lasts.

OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE:
Our client is seeking an experienced Business Architect to support a major business transformation initiative. This is an on-site contract opportunity based in Moncton, New Brunswick, with an anticipated 12-month term and strong potential for extension. The successful candidate will focus on understanding and optimizing business capabilities, end-to-end processes, and cross-functional dependencies to enable improved business outcomes.

Working closely with business stakeholders, you will analyze current-state operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and help shape future-state processes that drive efficiency, alignment, and organizational success. This role requires a strategic thinker with hands-on experience in business architecture, process mapping, gap analysis, and facilitating cross-functional discussions to achieve desired business outcomes.

WHAT YOU LL BE DOING IN THE ROLE:
• Lead business capability and end-to-end process mapping across multiple business functions.

• Document and assess current-state business processes, workflows, and operational dependencies.

• Facilitate future-state design sessions and workshops with business stakeholders.

• Identify process, data, and organizational gaps impacting business performance.

• Analyze upstream and downstream dependencies to ensure alignment across business areas.

• Facilitate cross-functional discussions to define business needs, challenges, and desired outcomes.

• Develop recommendations for process improvements and business transformation initiatives.

• Create process maps, business architecture artifacts, and supporting documentation.

• Collaborate with business leaders to prioritize opportunities and support implementation planning.

• Ensure business requirements and recommended solutions align with strategic objectives.

WHAT SKILLS / QUALIFICATIONS YOU LL NEED TO DO THE JOB:
• 7+ years of experience in Business Architecture, Business Analysis, Process Improvement, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience with business capability mapping and business architecture frameworks.

• Strong experience with end-to-end process mapping and process optimization.

• Proven ability to perform current-state assessments, future-state design, and gap analysis.

• Experience identifying process, data, and dependency issues within complex organizations.

• Strong stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation skills.

• Ability to translate business challenges into practical, actionable recommendations.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting large-scale business transformation or modernization initiatives.

• Knowledge of business architecture methodologies and best practices.

• Experience with process modeling tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, ARIS, or similar platforms.

• Business Architecture Guild, CBAP, Lean Six Sigma, TOGAF, or related certifications are considered assets.

## AND YOU ARE...

• Always improving your skills and knowledge: you want to be the best at what you do

• Curious and creative; comfortable taking on new problems and challenges

• A self-starter with the ability to recommend priorities to the project leader

• Comfortable working through problems and figuring things out with minimal supervision

• Great problem-solving skills: thorough and reliable

• Able to work in a team: share knowledge and assist other team members

• A good communicator: able to explain your ideas and recommendations

• Well organized and dependable under pressure: you manage your time effectively

• Energized by our company values!

## MARINER OFFERS YOU:

• A values-driven workplace where people really matter.

• Competitive salary, retirement savings program, and rewards program

• Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans and access to e-health care

• Paid vacation, maternity/parental leave, paid sick leave and paid Mariner MyLife days

• Unlimited training

## WHY MARINER?

We believe in making a positive impact in the communities where we live and work! Not only are we passionate about nurturing a thriving technology sector here in Atlantic Canada, but we are also committed to solving technology challenges that will make an impact worldwide. Technology is everlasting, and we take pride in connecting world class talent to world class projects and business solutions.

If you are an IT Professional, Software Professional, or Management Consultant, that is passionate about career development, data, and problem solving, we want to hear from you! If this sounds like someone you know, share this with them so they do not miss the opportunity to experience Mariner!

To achieve this, we know we need to be all in on training and development of our team so we can continue to move the needle in the technology sector together. Of course, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to our team, but our competitive edge is the development and training that our team experiences every day.

Be part of our vibrant community that values diversity and embraces inclusion at every level. We are committed to fostering a culture where individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life feel empowered to contribute their unique perspectives. Our collaborative environment celebrates the richness of ideas and experiences, and we believe that by embracing diversity, we can achieve greater innovation and excellence together. Come and help us create a workplace that reflects the beautiful tapestry of our global community.

## Join our growing team!

Reporting to the Director of Product Management, the Learning Ecosystem Support Specialist provides advanced technical support for the Canadian Red Cross Learning Ecosystem, including the external administration portal, eCommerce platform, Brightspace LMS, CRM integrations, identity services, and related applications. The role serves as the primary technical escalation point for cross-platform issues, integration failures, and end-to-end transaction troubleshooting across the learning technology ecosystem.

• Investigate, diagnose, and resolve web-layer technical issues within D2L Brightspace, admin portal and eCommerce platform including HTTP errors, rendering glitches, and application timeouts.

• Review browser developer tools, console logs, network payloads, and application logs to identify front-end and back-end performance bottlenecks.

• Diagnose and resolve issues reported by customer service related to system configurations.

• Coordinate with internal Technology Group and D2L support to ensure issues are assigned to the appropriate support group.

• Maintain clear and concise case notes documenting the issue, investigation, actions taken and resolution details for each support ticket.

• Ensure internal stakeholder are informed of the ticket status, progress, and resolution activities while coordinating with the Customer Service Escalation Specialist to maintain macros/scripts.

• Document system configurations, troubleshooting playbooks, and root-cause analyses for the internal knowledge base.

• Develop a strong understanding of the Prevention& Safety business and delivery service model.

• Ensure all established processes and quality controls have been completed prior to ticket closures.

• Interact with Product Owner, D2L Technical Advisor Manager (TAM) and internal Technology Group team to validate product software issues and assist in their resolution.

• Take ownership of the support tickets assigned and be responsible for them until resolution and for communication with internal staff.

• Maintain a current skill set on third Party D2L applications used by external customers and internal staff.

• Train Tier 2 staff on high-level troubleshooting steps to provide sufficient details in support ticket.

## What we are looking for:

• College degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field or 2 + years of previous technical support experience or equivalent experience.

• 7 + years of experience administering, configuring or supporting web eCommerce, admin portals or D2L Brightspace platform.

• Strong technical understanding of web infrastructure, including HTTP/S protocols, web servers, DNS, and SSL/TLS certificates

• Proficiency in using web browser debugging tools (Chrome DevTools) to analyze network traffic and console errors.

• Experience with Microsoft D365 (e.g. CRM & F&O) or related is required.

• Practical knowledge of web standards and coding in (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript) and API integrations (REST, JSON, LTI 1.3).

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with demonstrated comprehensive troubleshooting tactics.

• Ability to tailor explanations of technical concepts to the end user audience.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are a must.

• Proficiency in English oral and written, is required.

• Familiarity with Vue.js is preferred but not required.

## Working Conditions:

• Ability to work from home as the primary workspace.

• As we work with and support people (managers, colleagues, beneficiaries/customers, volunteers, donors and external partners) and communities in Canada and around the world, applicants whose first language is not English may be required to perform the responsibilities of the role in English.

If you are not a citizen or permanent resident of Canada, we encourage you to carefully review your visa to find out whether you are eligible to work in the job you are considering applying for. title: Supervisor, Production
description:
Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is transforming the future?

## Who We Are

We are Vale Base Metals – a global supplier of the critical minerals transforming the future.

With industry-leading reserves of copper and nickel in Canada, Brazil, and Indonesia, and state-of-the-art infrastructure in the U.K., Canada, and Japan, VBM delivers a secure and responsible supply of high-quality products to customers across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Global demand for critical minerals is growing exponentially. From energy to aerospace, batteries to magnets, robotics to artificial intelligence, a secure and responsible supply of critical minerals is fundamental to power modern technologies. And at Vale Base Metals, we are transforming our business to provide a secure and responsible supply of these minerals.

Join our diverse team of 13,000 talented individuals committed to providing mineral security to a world in transition. We invite you to put your skills to work, driving meaningful and enduring change while enjoying a rewarding career.

## The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Supervisor, Production to join our North Mine in Sudbury, Ontario.

The role is a permanent onsite position, working 5/4 rotating days and afternoons. This posting is for an existing position vacancy.

As a Supervisor, Production you will continuously improve the work team performance through the effective use of established processes and procedures in achieving assigned objectives following Vale's Safety Policies, Programs, and Legislative Standards.

Additionally, in this position you will:

• Lead and manage operations to achieve safe, efficient, and cost-effective production and maintenance targets.

• Promote a Zero Harm culture by ensuring compliance with safety programs, procedures, and risk management practices.

• Monitor production, quality, cost, and capital performance, taking corrective action as needed to meet targets.

• Conduct crew line-ups, communicate risks, manage incident reporting, and participate in investigations.

• Support injury management and employee return-to-work programs in collaboration with healthcare providers.

• Manage workforce performance through training, qualification tracking, coaching, mentoring, discipline, and grievance resolution.

• Coordinate resources, inventories, materials, overtime, and work schedules to support operational requirements.

• Plan, assign, monitor, and continuously improve work execution while ensuring accurate reporting, work order completion, and effective shift handovers.

• Participation in a competitive Defined Contribution Pension package

• Comprehensive benefits package (company paid core coverage, health and dental coverage, flex accounts, disability plans and optional insurances)

• Leave for all of life's reasons (vacation, personal, sick, parental)

• Work culture dedicated to safety, diversity & inclusion, and career growth

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Virtual Healthcare online

• Online training and career development opportunities

## About You

## Education:

• Common Core: First Line Underground Mine Supervisor Common Core (770121) or Common Core for First Line Production Supervisor Underground Hard Rock Mining (770120) is preferred.

## Experience:

• Experience working underground is preferred.

• Experience with Microsoft Office Products is required.

## Skills:

• Ability to work with minimal supervision and work well with others in a team environment.

• Must have strong written and oral communication skills.

• Must be obsessed with safety and risk.

• Must demonstrate open and transparent dialogue in all aspects of work

## Why Sudbury

Greater Sudbury is a vibrant city in northeastern Ontario, renowned for its rich mining history and significant role in Canada's mineral production. The city sits atop one of the world's largest and oldest meteorite impact sites, the Sudbury Basin, which is exceptionally rich in nickel, copper, and other critical minerals that are required for modern technologies such as AI and defence. The mining sector is a cornerstone of Sudbury's economy, driving both employment and economic growth, and Vale Base Metals plays a pivotal role in this regard. Our commitment to the community is as deep as our mines.

## Include to Transform

At Vale Base Metals, we are committed to ensuring an inclusive work environment where people can act like owners, being their authentic selves and empowering them to deliver results. Vale Base Metals encourages everyone to express their ideas and opinions and values the plurality of individual profiles. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are critical to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or any other personal consideration that makes us different

In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, accommodation is available throughout our recruitment process for applicants with disabilities

Employees engaged by the Company must be lawfully able to work for the Company in the country where the role is located. The Company does not provide immigration, work permit, or permanent residence sponsorship or assistance.

description:

## Job Summary:

Reporting to the Director, Strategic Growth & Partnerships (SG&P), the Sr. Health Systems Specialist, Strategic Growth & Partnerships (Sr. Specialist) is a key member of the Engagement & Philanthropy team responsible for strategic growth, including analytical, advisory and consultative services, reporting, program development, program implementation and advocacy. The Sr. Specialist manages the development and deployment of provincial strategic programs and is responsible for the evaluation and successful delivery of program outcomes.

## Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Health System Analytics, Advisement and Communications

• Performs environmental health system scanning activities which include the interpretation of issues, assessment of risks and identification of potential impacts on strategic growth priorities. Provides recommendations and key insights to drive corporate strategy.

• Monitors provincial healthcare systems' objectives, emerging trends, and challenges; leads program analysis options; provides strategic advice; identifies issues and trends; and provides recommendations on existing and future funding opportunities within the province to their Director and other leaders in the organization as required.

• Provides strategic growth advisory services to senior management, including the preparation and creation of briefing/issue notes, position papers and reports

• Manages strategic planning that anticipates and absorbs complex, mid to large scale issues and recognizes the interdependencies of Policy and Legislative implementation as it relates to strategic growth

• Identifies and manages contentious issues demonstrating sound judgement, sensitivity and a high degree of political acuity in the setting of priorities

• Supports organizational planning by addressing gaps and aligning growth with VON's strategic goals and priorities

Program Development

• Using a deep understanding of the health system, environment and VON funder/payer goals, the Sr. Specialist will partner with provincial and regional leadership to support the development of funder, payer and advocacy organization submissions, reports and presentations and other documentation that promote the value of existing and new VON programs, models and associated program funding

• Develops reports, key messaging, proposals, presentations, and other documents to support the communication of VON program value to our funders, payers, and advocacy organizations. This includes analyzing and interpreting statistical data and monitoring quality, performance indicators, and benchmarks.

• Follows business development methodology and supports and monitors the consistent use of this methodology within the organization.

• Supports organizational capacity by using a standard approach for proposals created for external stakeholders, partners, funders, and payers and developing templates that operations and teams can utilize.

• Supports the operation and corporate teams with relevant information, strategy, positioning, and documentation to help them succeed in their business development endeavours.

• Collaborates with departments/sites across the organization in identifying and developing program and service business opportunities

• Builds internal and external partnerships, influences, and negotiates between partners to achieve a shared optimized goal.

Program Management

• Manages a provincial portfolio of strategic growth projects and initiatives to produce high quality results on time through team-based approaches utilizing Lean and project management principles

• Establishes program outcome measures and evaluation criteria aligned with the requirements of funders, payers and strategic partners. This includes the use of qualitative and quantitative methods to meet the quadruple aim

• Leads the successful implementation of the project and/or initiative and ensures that the project/initiative remains within scope, is delivered on time, and within budget as determined through the agreement between the funder and VON

• Provides leadership to projects and small teams to bring the program design to life and ensure a sustainable transition to the operating teams

## Common Responsibilities:

• Promotes the goals and values of VON and their role as an integrated community care provider

• Promotes a safe and healthy workplace, ensuring workplace conduct and activities are in accordance with the provincial Occupational Health and Safety Act and Regulations.

• Abides by all VON policies and work practices

• Abides by all confidentiality and protection of personal information policies, regulations and practices and ensures appropriate safeguards are in place within their role

• Works in collaboration with other staff in a team approach to service delivery

## External and Internal Relationships:

• Liaises with and presents to internal and external stakeholder groups, including governmental agencies in both Ontario and Nova Scotia and other system partners.

• Establishes effective working relationships and communications with VON national and regional leadership teams to execute priority growth opportunities, partner engagements and business development

• Identifies and develops working relationships with key external stakeholders and represents VON on consultations, negotiations and working groups; and,

• Works closely with external project stakeholders in launching of programs, paying close attention to process and approach for project evaluation and outcomes.

## Education, Designations and Experience:

• Post-secondary degree in a Health Care Profession, Social Sciences, Business Administration, Health Policy or related field. Master's degree preferred.

• Minimum of 5 years' experience in program planning, health policy, project management, and/or strategic planning (in a health-related environment preferred).

• Knowledge of Provincial health care systems, objectives, emerging trends, and challenges.

• A strong understanding of LEAN principles and methodologies, LEAN certification (minimum Green Belt) is preferred.

• Project Management designation or certification considered an asset.

• Proven experience leading projects and work teams, from program ideation to delivery and iteration, to solve and meet strategic growth objectives.

• Demonstrated analytical, problem solving, conflict resolution, negotiation, strategic and systems thinking and decision-making skills.

• Experience working with qualitative and quantitative data and ability to analyze information to identify priorities and emerging issues.

• Experience conducting literature reviews, environmental scans, and appraisal and synthesis of research and other information to inform service delivery.

• Experience in policy analysis, development, modernization processes and implementation.

• Advisory and consultation skills to discuss and resolve diverse and competing policy and program related issues.

• Prior experience working in a Home and Community organization considered an asset.

• Prior experience in business development considered an asset.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Suite applications, internet, email, and the ability to use health information systems for decision support.

## Skill Requirements:

• Strategic thinker who has a strong understanding of funding opportunities within the Health and Community sector, keeps current on trends and industry developments, understands home and community care operations and can articulate a plan and translate it into strategies to support the achievement of organizational objectives

• Provides a positive example to VON by acting as a change champion, modelling an openness to learning new things and exploring new possibilities.

• Embeds a people-centered approach to program development and implementation • Ability to exercise innovation and initiative in solving problems and identifying opportunities

• Strong project management skills.

• Strong planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to relate effectively with people and resolve conflict with both internal and external parties.

• Ability to work collaboratively to resolve issues and negotiate changes and shifts in priorities.

• Excellent change leadership skills.

• Strong active listening and critical thinking skills.

• Strong research and investigative skills.

• Excellent written, presentation and oral communication skills.

• Strong organizational skills, including the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and ambiguity in a time-sensitive environment.

## Other

• A current and original satisfactory Criminal Records Check is required upon the start of your employment

• A Vulnerable Sector Search and/or Child Abuse Registry Check may be required

• Travel and irregular work schedules as required

Working conditions and physical demands: This role requires a detail-oriented approach in a dynamic environment, with physical activity including lifting, carrying (using proper techniques), bending, reaching, kneeling, and other movements that emphasize good body mechanics. Individuals in the role are required to walk, sit, stand, and climb stairs throughout the day, with some tasks requiring fine hand movements.

title: Buyer/Purchaser Intermediate
description:
Requisition ID: 2252

Why Choose IMP Aerospace & Defence:
IMP Aerospace & Defence is not only one of the leading companies in the Aerospace field, but we are also one of the most engaging and equality advocating companies to work for. We believe that regardless of where you work at IMP Aerospace & Defence, you are a part of our ever-growing team. IMP is able to achieve success through this teamwork mindset. That is why at IMP, you are not defined by your role.

Position Overview:
Reporting to the Aerospace Procurement Manager, the successful candidate will integrate with the existing procurement team in providing timely and cost-effective procurement, including value added sourcing and ordering of parts, materials, equipment and services by applying and adhering to best supply chain practices.

What You Will Do:
• Source parts, materials, equipment and services from established vendors as well as establish new vendors as required

• Implement and execute commodity strategy to support cost, quality, supplier reduction, and delivery sourcing goals

• Review internal requests, prepare and release requests for quote (RFQ), and negotiate pricing with suppliers

• Create purchase orders with approved suppliers in accordance with Standard Plant Procedures (SPP's) and Administrative Directives (AD's)

• Responsible for the management of purchase orders in the MRP system (JD Edwards)

• Develop supplier relationships to ensure all parts & materials meet the requirements of internal and external customers

• Action discrepant, defective or unacceptable products/services with Receiving Inspection, Receiving and Quality Assurance departments, end users, vendors and others to determine the source and root cause of the problem and action the necessary corrective / preventative actions as required

• Resolve invoice discrepancies accurately and in a timely manner

• Interface with key stakeholders in a proactive manner to obtain and provide information, including procurement technical advice in support of overall operations

• Recommend and implement cost reduction initiatives

• Work within and promote Lean practices to meet departmental and divisional goals

• Meet industry representatives on behalf of the company

• Carry out special assignments as required

What You Will Bring:
• Preference given to candidate with post-secondary education with 4 to 7 years' experience in supply chain ideally in the aerospace and/or aviation industries; or same level of experience in a similar type of complex and dynamic technical environment

• Supply Management Training (SMT) Program, Supply Chain Management Professional (SCMP) Designation, P.Log. or equivalent

• Skill in using MRP system; knowledge of JD Edwards would be considered an asset

• Intermediate to advanced computer skills – Emphasis on MS Office and use of MRP/ERP systems

• Experience in aerospace purchasing an asset

• Dynamic and have the ability to multi-task and shift priorities in a very demanding work environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and detail

• Strong communication skills

• Incumbents must be able to pass and maintain (PSPC) Public Services and Procurement Canada and Transport Canada security clearances

• Demonstrate a personal commitment to IMP Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies. Continually focusing on your individual safety and the safety of others who may be affected by your work and to fully comply with all Federal Health and Safety Legislation.

• Must be eligible to meet requirements for Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP), Secret Level II Security Clearance through PSPC - Contract Security Program, and Transport Canada RAIC clearance.

What We Will Do For You:
• All of IMP's benefits become effective on your first day of work, regardless of your position.

• We offer a comprehensive Benefits Package, including RSP Program, Tuition Reimbursement Program, Long Service Awards, Volunteer Grant Program, Scholarship Program, and more!

IMP is committed to Employment Equity and our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels.
